body.zh: Civilization VI版CivBench通过76个MCP工具和文字叙述层，让语言模型进行完整文明经营；一局超过300回合并产生数千次查询与管理调用。
body.en: The Civilization VI CivBench provides 76 MCP tools and textual narration for full-game management across 300-plus turns and thousands of tool calls.

body.zh: 研究关注长期计划能否落实，以及智能体是否主动查询潜在战略状态；只有实际查询的信息进入观察，因此工具访问与主动监控行为分别可分析。
body.en: The work studies plan execution and proactive monitoring of latent strategic state, with observations limited to explicitly queried information.

body.zh: 固定地图与游戏种子、存档、版本及共享行动手册，记录PMR主动监控率、RAG@10十回合承诺兑现和终局结果；原始研究包含23次有效运行。
body.en: Pinned seeds, saves, versions and a shared playbook support PMR monitoring, RAG@10 commitment execution and terminal outcomes across 23 admissible runs.

body.zh: 23次有效运行用于行为刻画，PMR和RAG@10衡量共享手册条件下的主动查询与承诺兑现，终局结果提供整局表现背景。
body.en: Twenty-three admissible runs characterize behavior, with PMR/RAG@10 measuring querying and commitment execution under a shared playbook alongside terminal outcomes.

body.zh: TowerMind以轻量塔防环境连接语言模型与即时战略决策，智能体建造或升级防御、部署单位，阻止敌人抵达拥有20点生命的基地。
body.en: TowerMind provides a lightweight tower-defense setting in which agents build or upgrade defenses and deploy units to protect a 20-health base.

body.zh: 研究用文字、结构状态与图像输入比较决策和动作幻觉，设置五个内置关卡，同时报告语言模型、人类专家和强化学习基线的表现。
body.en: Five built-in levels compare textual, structured and visual inputs, studying decisions and invalid actions with language models, human experts and RL baselines.

body.zh: 模型看到状态规则和最近三次交互，视觉条件另加512×512图像；每16步选择坐标及12类命令，五随机种子，漏敌一只扣一分，分数−20至0。
body.en: Agents receive rules/state and three recent interactions, optionally 512×512 images, choosing coordinates plus one of 12 commands every 16 steps; five seeds yield leak scores from −20 to zero.

body.zh: 五关卡分别比较文字与视觉条件，漏敌分数评价防守效果，有效动作比例评价命令合法性；基地生命和16步决策间隔界定时序。
body.en: Five levels compare text/vision conditions; leak scores assess defense and valid-action rates assess command legality under 20 health and 16-step decisions.

body.zh: Factorio Learning Environment让语言智能体通过Python代码与工具经营工厂，接收执行输出和错误反馈，逐步安排采集、设备、物流与生产链。
body.en: Factorio Learning Environment lets language agents manage factories through Python code/tools, using execution output and errors to develop resource, machine and logistics chains.

body.zh: 论文区分程序化地图上扩张最大工厂的Open-play，以及固定资源下33项有界Lab-play任务，研究规划、空间布局、程序合成与资源优化。
body.en: The paper separates open-ended factory growth on procedural maps from 33 bounded fixed-resource lab tasks, studying planning, spatial layout, program synthesis and resource optimization.

body.zh: 当前细化入口为Open-play生产扩张，按所用版本生产分数评价工厂；资源、科技、API与测量窗口共同规定条件，代码提交次数与游戏时间属于不同预算。
body.en: The detailed entry follows Open-play production growth using version-specific production scores; resources, technology, APIs and measurement windows define conditions, separating code submissions from game time.

body.zh: Open-play评价开放式生产扩张，Lab-play评价固定资源任务；Python工具、评分版本和测量窗口定义工厂控制与产出的具体含义。
body.en: Open-play measures factory expansion and Lab-play fixed-resource tasks; Python tools, scorer version and measurement windows define control and production outcomes.

body.zh: Mini Honor of Kings提供轻量王者荣耀环境及地图编辑器，允许研究者定制场景；论文的实际任务是五名英雄协作攻击黑暗暴君。
body.en: Mini Honor of Kings offers a lightweight environment and map editor; the paper's evaluated task uses five heroes cooperating against the Dark Dragon.

body.zh: 研究在保留多智能体挑战的同时降低计算需求，用随机首领技能和英雄差异检验协同策略，并比较常用多智能体强化学习算法。
body.en: The work reduces computational cost while retaining coordination challenges from stochastic boss skills and heterogeneous heroes, comparing common MARL algorithms.

body.zh: 策略观察己方和首领位置、生命，执行八方向移动、攻击及技能；集中训练可用联合观察，七种等级、装备、技能与队伍配置，五种子各训练一万回合。指标为队伍累计伤害及学习曲线。
body.en: Policies observe own/dragon positions and health and select movement, attacks and skills; seven controlled configurations use five seeds and 10,000 episodes, with joint observations for centralized training. Metrics are team damage and learning curves.

body.zh: 实测七配置聚焦五英雄对首领的合作伤害，等级、技能、装备和队伍组成分别受控；地图编辑器提供其他场景的扩展接口。
body.en: Seven evaluated configurations focus on five-hero cooperative boss damage, controlling levels, skills, equipment and composition within an extensible map-editor platform.

paragraphs.zh: Mini Honor of Kings提供轻量王者荣耀环境及地图编辑器，允许研究者定制场景；论文的实际任务是五名英雄协作攻击黑暗暴君。
paragraphs.en: Mini Honor of Kings offers a lightweight environment and map editor; the paper's evaluated task uses five heroes cooperating against the Dark Dragon.

paragraphs.zh: 研究在保留多智能体挑战的同时降低计算需求，用随机首领技能和英雄差异检验协同策略，并比较常用多智能体强化学习算法。
paragraphs.en: The work reduces computational cost while retaining coordination challenges from stochastic boss skills and heterogeneous heroes, comparing common MARL algorithms.

paragraphs.zh: 策略观察己方和首领位置、生命，执行八方向移动、攻击及技能；集中训练可用联合观察，七种等级、装备、技能与队伍配置，五种子各训练一万回合。指标为队伍累计伤害及学习曲线。
paragraphs.en: Policies observe own/dragon positions and health and select movement, attacks and skills; seven controlled configurations use five seeds and 10,000 episodes, with joint observations for centralized training. Metrics are team damage and learning curves.

paragraphs.zh: 实测七配置聚焦五英雄对首领的合作伤害，等级、技能、装备和队伍组成分别受控；地图编辑器提供其他场景的扩展接口。
paragraphs.en: Seven evaluated configurations focus on five-hero cooperative boss damage, controlling levels, skills, equipment and composition within an extensible map-editor platform.

body.zh: TextStarCraft II把星际争霸资源、建筑、单位、敌情和历史摘要转成文字，让模型通过执行器调度的建造、生产与研究宏动作经营完整对局。
body.en: TextStarCraft II converts resources, buildings, units, enemy information and history into text, enabling full-game management through executor-scheduled build, production and research macros.

body.zh: 研究提出Chain of Summarization，把单帧状态压缩与多帧战略总结相结合，考察语言模型能否利用游戏知识和历史选择长期行动。
body.en: Chain of Summarization combines single-frame compression with multi-frame strategic summaries to study whether language models turn knowledge and history into long-term decisions.

body.zh: 已核协议是Protoss对内置Zerg AI的闭环比赛，按难度与提示报告胜率，调用量和时间另计，并比较摘要方法；静态知识问答是另一部分。
body.en: The verified gameplay protocol uses Protoss against built-in Zerg AI, reporting wins by difficulty/prompt and separate API/time costs while comparing summarization; static QA is separate.

body.zh: 具体比赛采用文字宏动作控制Protoss对Zerg AI，按难度和提示呈现胜率；摘要、人类专家意见与静态知识问答属于不同分析维度。
body.en: Concrete matches use textual macros for Protoss versus Zerg AI, with difficulty/prompt-specific wins; summarization, expert opinions and static QA are separate analyses.

body.zh: WGSR-Bench以妙算兵棋的战场画面与行为记录组织战略推理样本，核心任务包括环境态势理解、对手风险建模和策略生成。
body.en: WGSR-Bench derives strategic-reasoning samples from MiaoSuan wargame scenes and behavior records, covering situation awareness, opponent-risk modeling and policy generation.

body.zh: 论文提出S-POE结构，将战场认知、对手特质与策略预测结合，研究模型在不确定、对抗且存在多种合理选择时如何推断局势并提出计划。
body.en: The S-POE architecture connects battlefield understanding, opponent traits and strategy prediction to study reasoning under uncertainty and competing plausible choices.

body.zh: 已核细节包含态势理解多选题，以及根据对手行为判断特质或预测策略；评分针对回答与预测内容，数据来自兵棋对局截图和回放。
body.en: Verified components include multiple-choice situation questions and trait/strategy predictions from opponent behavior, scoring answers and predictions derived from screenshots and replays.

body.zh: 本资源的具体评测单元是场景问答与行为推断，兵棋平台提供素材和语义背景；完整论文另讨论将这些推理组件接入智能体的架构。
body.en: The concrete evaluation units are scene questions and behavioral inference, with the wargame supplying source material and semantics; the paper also discusses integrating the reasoning components into an agent.

body.zh: Hokoff汇集王者荣耀预先采集的真实对局数据，分别支持1v1离线强化学习和3v3离线多智能体强化学习，提供配套基准框架。
body.en: Hokoff supplies precollected Honor of Kings gameplay for 1v1 offline RL and 3v3 offline MARL, with a corresponding benchmark framework.

body.zh: 研究围绕复杂层级动作、不同数据质量、泛化与多任务学习比较行为克隆和离线强化学习，并提出适配按钮、目标和参数结构的基线。
body.en: The work compares behavior cloning and offline RL across data quality, generalization and multitask settings, including a baseline tailored to hierarchical actions.

body.zh: 策略读取局部英雄和单位特征，离线学习后与多个训练阶段的PPO参考对手在线对战，以胜率衡量表现，分开记录英雄阵容、数据质量与对手等级。
body.en: Policies learn from local hero/unit features and face multiple pretrained PPO opponent checkpoints online, measuring win rates by roster, dataset quality and opponent level.

body.zh: 数据集、训练阶段与在线对手评测共同构成协议；1v1和3v3采用各自任务配置，胜率对应特定参考对手与动作结构。
body.en: Datasets, offline training and online opponent evaluation jointly define the protocol. The 1v1 and 3v3 settings retain their own configurations and reference-opponent win rates.

body.zh: SMACv2让多个智能体分别控制StarCraft II单位，在局部观察下通过移动、停止、攻击或治疗配合击败敌队，专注合作战斗微操。
body.en: SMACv2 assigns individual StarCraft II units to decentralized agents that coordinate movement, stopping, attacks or healing from local observations.

body.zh: 改进版随机化起始位置和单位构成，减少固定地图脚本策略的作用，以可配置能力分布研究多智能体强化学习的泛化。
body.en: Randomized starting positions and unit compositions reduce reliance on fixed scripts and provide configurable capability distributions for studying MARL generalization.

body.zh: 环境以battles_won除以battles_game计算队伍胜率，另记录超时；训练中的全局状态访问、视野、兵种分布、地图和步进共同定义场景。
body.en: Team win rate is battles_won divided by battles_game, with timeouts recorded separately; global-state access, sight range, unit distributions, maps and stepping define settings.

body.zh: 评测对象是随机战斗场景中的去中心化协作，观测与可用动作随配置变化；单位经济、生产建造和整局科技运营属于其他RTS任务层级。
body.en: Evaluation concerns decentralized cooperation in randomized combat, with observations and available actions set by configuration; full-game economics, construction and technology are distinct RTS layers.

body.zh: Honor of Kings Arena通过Python接口提供王者荣耀1v1对抗，包含20个可控制英雄，围绕不同控制对象与不同对手研究竞争强化学习泛化。
body.en: Honor of Kings Arena exposes 1v1 gameplay through Python and provides 20 controllable heroes for competitive-RL generalization across controlled and opposing characters.

body.zh: 环境给出英雄公开和私有信息、兵线、防御塔、水晶及比赛阶段特征，动作分解为按钮、目标、移动或技能方向，保留MOBA战斗与推塔目标。
body.en: Structured observations cover hero state, creeps, towers, crystals and match phases; hierarchical actions combine buttons, targets and movement/skill directions.

body.zh: 已细化实验控制貂蝉，固定出装与升级，在同英雄训练后替换行为树对手英雄，进行98场跨对手测试，报告胜率、奖励、每帧伤害和模型池Elo。
body.en: The detailed experiment fixes Diaochan, purchases and upgrades, then changes behavior-tree opponent heroes for 98 cross-opponent matches, reporting wins, reward, damage per frame and model-pool Elo.

body.zh: 平台提供多英雄对抗空间，当前具体证据集中于貂蝉的对手迁移；行为树难度定位描述基准对手，1v1胜率对应双方英雄与固定运营配置。
body.en: The platform offers a broader hero space while detailed evidence centers on Diaochan opponent transfer; behavior-tree difficulty and fixed purchasing/upgrades define the reference matches.

body.zh: Gym-μRTS把完整微型即时战略对局接入强化学习接口，角色需分配工人采集资源、生产部队、调度单位并击败对手。
body.en: Gym-μRTS exposes full micro-RTS games for reinforcement learning, requiring resource gathering, unit production, movement and combat.

body.zh: 研究以低成本模拟和训练技术降低完整RTS的计算负担，通过消融分析各项扩展方法，并在单机条件下训练可对抗既有竞赛机器人的策略。
body.en: The work combines efficient simulation and training techniques for affordable full RTS, using ablations and single-machine training against prior competition bots.

body.zh: 策略输入27个二值特征平面，逐单位选择移动、采集、返还、生产、攻击或等待；四训练种子选最佳，单地图对13个对手各100局，4000 tick上限，报告累计胜率。
body.en: Policies use 27 binary feature planes and primitive per-unit actions. The best of four seeds faces 13 bots for 100 games each on one map, with a 4,000-tick cap and cumulative win rate.

body.zh: 论文结果对应完全观测、单地图、最佳训练种子选择的完整对局；模型大小与运行时间提供效率维度，资源运营和战斗在同一胜负目标下联合评价。
body.en: Results concern fully observed, single-map full games with best-seed selection. Model size/runtime add efficiency measures while economics and combat share the game outcome.

body.zh: BVR Sim 将超视距空战建成可配置的在线强化学习环境，支持多种飞机、传感器、武器和脚本对手。策略读取实体化战术信息，输出目标航向、高度、速度与武器释放命令，由机型专属内环执行。
body.en: BVR Sim is an online reinforcement-learning environment for beyond-visual-range air combat, with configurable aircraft, sensors, weapons and scripted opponents. Entity-based observations feed tactical heading, altitude, speed and weapon-release commands executed by aircraft-specific controllers.

body.zh: 研究重点是部分可观测交战中的能量与有限弹药管理，以及统一战术接口能否支持异构机型策略迁移；Python与加速C++后端也服务于高吞吐训练。
body.en: It studies energy and limited-weapon management under partial observability, and whether a common tactical interface transfers policies across aircraft. Python and accelerated C++ backends support training throughput.

body.zh: 代表评测将仅在F-16训练的策略冻结，在其他机型上对阵固定1对1脚本对手；每个策略与机型组合运行960回合，以各机型胜率衡量迁移。
body.en: The reviewed transfer experiment freezes an F-16-trained policy and tests other aircraft against a fixed scripted 1v1 opponent, reporting per-aircraft win rates over 960 episodes per policy–aircraft pair.

body.zh: 资源包括跨机型迁移和多代理训练集成两类实验；前者衡量冻结策略在机型控制器适配后的交战胜率，后者记录MAPPO/HAPPO与多机环境的集成表现。
body.en: The resource includes transfer and multi-agent integration experiments. Transfer measures frozen-policy wins with adapted aircraft controllers; integration records MAPPO/HAPPO operation in multi-aircraft environments.

paragraphs.zh: 资源包括跨机型迁移和多代理训练集成两类实验；前者衡量冻结策略在机型控制器适配后的交战胜率，后者记录MAPPO/HAPPO与多机环境的集成表现。
paragraphs.en: The resource includes transfer and multi-agent integration experiments. Transfer measures frozen-policy wins with adapted aircraft controllers; integration records MAPPO/HAPPO operation in multi-aircraft environments.

body.zh: R2D-RL通过共享内存与逐周期同步，将RoboCup二维足球服务器及HELIOS球员接入Python多智能体学习。环境同时提供门前训练场景与11对11全场比赛。
body.en: R2D-RL connects the RoboCup 2D server and HELIOS player clients to Python multi-agent learning through shared memory and cycle-level synchronization, supporting both front-goal scenarios and full-field 11v11 play.

body.zh: 其研究问题是如何在局部观察和稀疏进球奖励下学习传球、无球支援与团队进攻，并比较高层离散动作、参数化动作、合法掩码和EPV奖励塑形。
body.en: It examines passing, off-ball support and coordinated attacks under local observations and sparse scoring rewards, comparing discrete and parameterized actions, masks and EPV reward shaping.

body.zh: 已细化的三种门前多攻击者场景对阵HELIOS防守者，训练500万步；测试以进球率及三个种子的均值和标准差报告，每局至多300步。
body.en: The three reviewed multi-attacker scenarios use HELIOS defenders and five million training steps. Evaluation reports goal rate with mean and standard deviation over three seeds and a 300-step episode cap.

body.zh: 三种门前场景覆盖Support Option、Passing Lane和Compact Defense；全场11对11是平台的另一层级。学习策略负责play_on阶段，其他比赛模式由HELIOS执行。
body.en: The reviewed front-goal tasks cover Support Option, Passing Lane and Compact Defense; full-field 11v11 is another platform level. Policies control play_on and HELIOS handles other modes.

body.zh: SVI-Bench以篮球、足球与冰球的真实比赛录像及解说、报告和统计构成多模态语料，将体育团队互动作为可核验规则与结果的动态微世界。模型处理视频与问题，而非操控场上球员。
body.en: SVI-Bench combines real basketball, soccer and hockey broadcasts with commentary, reports and statistics, using team sports as a microworld with explicit rules and outcomes. Models analyze videos and questions rather than control players.

body.zh: 九项任务沿动态场景理解、因果推理、策略模拟和智能体综合四个层次组织，考察从识别事件到解释成因、推演变化及综合分析的能力链。
body.en: Nine tasks span dynamic scene understanding, causal reasoning, strategic simulation and agentic synthesis, testing a progression from event recognition to explanations, counterfactual analysis and synthesis.

body.zh: 评测围绕各任务的问题、参考信息与输出要求展开；工具辅助的T9智能体用于回答分析问题。大规模视频、动作注释、专家解说与结构化记录为不同层次提供证据。
body.en: Task-specific questions, references and output requirements define evaluation; the tool-assisted T9 agent answers analytical questions. Video, action annotations, expert commentary and structured records supply complementary evidence.

body.zh: 资源对象是体育视频理解、生成与工具辅助分析，T9输出分析问题的答案。九任务成绩分别对应感知、因果、模拟和综合层次中的信息处理表现。
body.en: The resource covers sports-video understanding, generation and tool-assisted analysis; T9 produces analytical answers. Its scores describe information processing across perception, causality, simulation and synthesis.

body.zh: MMBench为连续控制研究提供200项跨领域与具身形态的任务，配有语言指令、示范和可选图像。论文以Newt共享世界模型结合示范预训练及多任务在线交互。
body.en: MMBench provides 200 continuous-control tasks across domains and embodiments, with language instructions, demonstrations and optional images. Newt combines demonstration pretraining with shared multitask online world-model learning.

body.zh: 研究关注在线强化学习的多任务扩展、数据效率、开环控制和未见任务适应；电子游戏构成控制套件中的一个子集，机器人与具身任务提供更广泛的迁移背景。
body.en: The research addresses multitask scaling, data efficiency, open-loop control and adaptation to unseen tasks. Video games form one subset of a broader control suite.

body.zh: 已核验的Atari例子包括Ms. Pac-Man与Space Invaders，主设定读取128维RAM和语言任务描述，连续输出经ALE转换为离散动作；每局固定1000步，逐游戏归一化回报。
body.en: The reviewed Atari examples are Ms. Pac-Man and Space Invaders. They use 128-dimensional RAM and task text, continuous outputs mapped to discrete ALE actions, 1,000-step episodes and game-specific normalized returns.

body.zh: 主实验默认使用状态输入，逐游戏归一化依据预设上下界；Ms. Pac-Man和Space Invaders是已细化的游戏子集，机器人迁移实验描述更广泛的控制泛化。
body.en: Primary experiments default to state input and preset game-specific normalization bounds. Ms. Pac-Man and Space Invaders form the reviewed game subset; robot-transfer experiments address broader control generalization.

body.zh: VolleyBots在物理仿真中让无人机进行排球运动，任务从单机练习延伸至多机合作与竞争。策略同时协调三维飞行、触球时机和队伍战术。
body.en: VolleyBots simulates drone volleyball under physical dynamics, ranging from individual drills to cooperative and competitive teams. Policies combine three-dimensional flight, contact timing and strategic play.

body.zh: 套件连接低层运动控制与高层策略，比较RL、MARL和博弈算法；论文还研究分层策略以及仿真策略向真实无人机的零样本部署。
body.en: The suite connects low-level control with strategy through RL, MARL and game-theoretic baselines, and studies hierarchical policies and zero-shot deployment on real drones.

body.zh: 已细化的Easy二传扣球任务要求二传触球、攻击者接球、向下扣球并落入目标区；800步内的四个指示量取平均，再汇总五个种子结果。
body.en: The reviewed Easy set-and-spike task scores setter contact, attacker contact, downward spiking and target landing. Its metric averages these four indicators within an 800-step cap and aggregates five seeds.

body.zh: Easy二传扣球以四阶段完成度均值计分，40维观察与锚点范围属于其配置。套件中的多机比赛和真实无人机部署使用各自任务条件。
body.en: Easy set-and-spike scores mean completion across four stages, with its own 40-dimensional observation and anchor bounds. Team matches and real-drone deployment use separate conditions.

body.zh: GRF-MARL在Google Research Football基础上统一多智能体环境设置与评测，并覆盖学院练习和5对5、11对11完整比赛。平台还提供种群自博弈、预训练策略和足球分析工具。
body.en: GRF-MARL standardizes multi-agent settings and evaluation on Google Research Football, covering academy drills and full 5v5 and 11v11 matches, with population self-play, pretrained policies and football analytics.

body.zh: 研究关注观察编码、奖励密度、参数共享与训练方法如何影响团队配合，以及如何提高大规模完整比赛的训练效率和比较一致性。
body.en: It studies how observation encodings, reward density, parameter sharing and training methods affect teamwork, training efficiency and consistent comparison in larger matches.

body.zh: 已登记的六类学院进攻场景包含3对1、传射、跑传射、角球及难易反击；非守门员使用19个离散动作，报告测试胜率并辅以传球和控球统计。
body.en: The six reviewed academy scenarios cover 3v1, passing, running passes, corners and easy/hard counterattacks. Non-goalkeepers use 19 discrete actions; evaluation reports win rates with passing and possession diagnostics.

body.zh: 学院场景在球权交换时终止，由内置AI控制守门员，主要观察进攻协作；完整比赛、观察编码和稀疏或稠密奖励分别定义不同实验条件。
body.en: Academy episodes end on possession exchange with AI goalkeepers, primarily measuring coordinated offense. Full matches, encodings and sparse/dense rewards define separate conditions.

body.zh: LM Fight Arena让多模态模型在Mortal Kombat II中直接对抗，读取采样画面、血量、位置、朝向与近期动作，再将自然语言按钮组合转换为模拟器操作。
body.en: LM Fight Arena pits multimodal models against each other in Mortal Kombat II. Agents read sampled frames, health, positions, facing and recent actions, then issue natural-language button combinations translated into emulator inputs.

body.zh: 其目标是把视觉理解与连续战术决策置于动态对抗中，通过统一角色和提示条件比较模型，而不是只判断静态图像或孤立问答。
body.en: It combines visual interpretation and sequential tactical decisions in dynamic competition, comparing models under common character and prompting conditions.

body.zh: 论文循环赛让双方使用Liu Kang，以胜率和获胜方剩余血量作为结果。输入包含十帧采样图像和最近五个动作，同一模拟器、角色和系统提示控制接口差异。
body.en: The round robin uses Liu Kang mirror matches and reports win rate and winner remaining health. Inputs include ten sampled frames and five recent actions, with matched emulator, character and system prompt.

body.zh: 成绩对应Mortal Kombat II的Liu Kang镜像赛，输入同时包含采样图像和结构化状态。论文使用每模型配对一次的循环赛，以具体对手池内的胜负和剩余血量描述表现。
body.en: Results describe Liu Kang mirror matches with both sampled images and structured state. One match per model pairing yields pool-specific wins and remaining-health outcomes.

body.zh: Memory Maze让第一人称代理在随机三维迷宫中，依颜色提示反复寻找目标；同一回合内地图与物体位置固定，记忆保存离开视野的目标与路径信息。
body.en: Memory Maze asks a first-person agent to repeatedly retrieve color-cued targets in randomized 3D mazes. Layout and object positions stay fixed within an episode, requiring memory of information no longer visible.

body.zh: 资源同时包含在线RL任务、离线轨迹数据与记忆探针，重点考察随时间整合观察、自我定位和空间地图保持，并以人类表现提供参照。
body.en: It combines an online RL benchmark, offline trajectories and memory probes to study temporal integration, localization and spatial-map retention, with a human reference.

body.zh: 标准接口为64×64 RGB和六个离散导航动作，每次到达正确目标奖励1。9、11、13、15格迷宫分别使用1000至4000步预算，按尺寸比较累计目标到达数。
body.en: The standard interface uses 64×64 RGB and six navigation actions, awarding one point per correct target. Maze sizes 9, 11, 13 and 15 use budgets of 1,000–4,000 steps and report targets reached by size.

body.zh: 标准任务按迷宫尺寸与步数预算比较目标到达数；ExtraObs提供额外观察条件。在线导航、离线数据学习及记忆探针分别观察空间记忆的使用与表征。
body.en: Standard tasks compare targets reached by maze size and budget; ExtraObs changes available information. Online navigation, offline learning and probes examine spatial-memory use and representation.

paragraphs.zh: Memory Maze让第一人称代理在随机三维迷宫中，依颜色提示反复寻找目标；同一回合内地图与物体位置固定，记忆保存离开视野的目标与路径信息。
paragraphs.en: Memory Maze asks a first-person agent to repeatedly retrieve color-cued targets in randomized 3D mazes. Layout and object positions stay fixed within an episode, requiring memory of information no longer visible.

paragraphs.zh: 资源同时包含在线RL任务、离线轨迹数据与记忆探针，重点考察随时间整合观察、自我定位和空间地图保持，并以人类表现提供参照。
paragraphs.en: It combines an online RL benchmark, offline trajectories and memory probes to study temporal integration, localization and spatial-map retention, with a human reference.

paragraphs.zh: 标准接口为64×64 RGB和六个离散导航动作，每次到达正确目标奖励1。9、11、13、15格迷宫分别使用1000至4000步预算，按尺寸比较累计目标到达数。
paragraphs.en: The standard interface uses 64×64 RGB and six navigation actions, awarding one point per correct target. Maze sizes 9, 11, 13 and 15 use budgets of 1,000–4,000 steps and report targets reached by size.

paragraphs.zh: 标准任务按迷宫尺寸与步数预算比较目标到达数；ExtraObs提供额外观察条件。在线导航、离线数据学习及记忆探针分别观察空间记忆的使用与表征。
paragraphs.en: Standard tasks compare targets reached by maze size and budget; ExtraObs changes available information. Online navigation, offline learning and probes examine spatial-memory use and representation.

body.zh: MATE构建摄像机与移动目标两支队伍的非对称合作竞争：摄像机调整方向和视角覆盖目标，目标则在仓库间运输货物并避免暴露。
body.en: MATE creates an asymmetric cooperative–competitive game: cameras control direction and viewing angle to track targets, while mobile targets transport cargo among warehouses and avoid exposure.

body.zh: 平台用于研究局部感知下的团队合作、通信、规模扩展、稳健性和非对称自博弈；两队拥有不同动作空间与奖励结构，可分别评估学习方法。
body.en: It studies cooperation, communication, scaling, robustness and asymmetric self-play under local perception. The teams have distinct action spaces and reward structures.

body.zh: 摄像机任务报告平均覆盖率，代表配置为4摄像机、8目标、9障碍；运输队使用二维连续位移，按固定运费及随耗时和暴露衰减的赏金计算归一化回报。
body.en: Cameras report mean coverage rate, including a four-camera/eight-target/nine-obstacle setting. Targets use continuous 2D displacement and normalized returns combining fixed freight with bounty that decays with time and detection.

body.zh: 摄像机覆盖率描述感知网络表现，运输回报结合效率与隐蔽性；通信、完整观察及规则底层执行的分层控制各有独立设定，两队策略按各自目标评价。
body.en: Coverage measures the camera network; transport returns combine efficiency and stealth. Communication, full observation and hierarchical controllers have distinct settings and team objectives.

body.zh: BotzoneBench基于Botzone竞赛平台，在八种完全或不完全信息游戏中让语言模型逐级挑战固定强度机器人；输入包含规则、文字状态、合法动作及适用历史。
body.en: BotzoneBench uses the Botzone platform to test LLMs against fixed graded bots across eight perfect- and imperfect-information games, supplying rules, text states, legal actions and relevant history.

body.zh: 固定技能锚点使评价可以随新模型加入持续比较，并降低全模型两两循环赛成本；研究关注模型在不同确定性、随机性与隐藏信息条件下的策略水平。
body.en: Fixed skill anchors support longitudinal comparison and reduce the cost of all-pairs model tournaments, exposing strategic differences across deterministic, stochastic and hidden-information games.

body.zh: 评测轮换座位并固定种子；完全信息配对32局、不完全信息64局。大多数游戏报告排除平局后的胜率与等级进度，井字棋则以和局率适应其胜负结构。
body.en: Evaluation rotates seats with fixed seeds, using 32 games for perfect-information and 64 for imperfect-information pairings. Most games report draw-excluded win rate and tier progress; Tic-Tac-Toe uses draw rate.

body.zh: 锚点层级由各游戏的专用机器人定义，成绩在对应游戏内解释；合法动作供应明确了辅助决策条件，座位轮换和固定种子为跨模型比较提供共同基础。
body.en: Specialized bots define game-specific anchor tiers. Supplied legal moves specify supported decision conditions, while seat rotation and fixed seeds provide common comparison settings.

body.zh: Chess-World-Model从一千万盘真实国际象棋构造状态跟踪数据：输入合法棋步序列，输出序列执行后的完整棋盘状态，不要求模型选择下一步。
body.en: Chess-World-Model builds a state-tracking dataset from ten million real chess games: models receive legal move sequences and predict the resulting complete board state rather than select a move.

body.zh: 研究通过统一接口比较Transformer与多种递归架构，探查状态转移表达能力；真实棋局与均匀随机合法走子划分用于区分规则学习和常见局面捷径。
body.en: It compares Transformers and recurrent architectures under a common interface, using real-game and uniformly random legal-play splits to distinguish transition-rule learning from familiar-position shortcuts.

body.zh: 核心ExactState要求75个标签全部正确，另报告标签准确率与整条轨迹的完全正确性；分布外随机走子使真实棋局上接近饱和的模型仍显露错误。
body.en: ExactState requires all 75 labels to be correct; label accuracy and trajectory exactness provide additional diagnostics. Random-play evaluation exposes failures hidden by saturation on real games.

body.zh: 评测以离线合法走子序列为输入、棋盘标签为输出，真实棋局与随机走子划分分别刻画分布内和分布外状态更新；完全匹配体现精确追踪程度。
body.en: Offline move sequences map to board labels. Real-game and random-play splits characterize in- and out-of-distribution updates; exact matching measures tracking precision.

body.zh: DungeonBench以D&D 2014规则内容构建战斗模拟器，向代理提供战术观察、当前决策与可执行选项，覆盖移动、攻击、法术、反应及有限资源选择。
body.en: DungeonBench implements D&D-2014-style combat with tactical observations, pending decisions and executable options for movement, attacks, spells, reactions and scarce resources.

body.zh: 它关注地形、行动经济、时机窗口与规则交互共同作用时的战术判断，并通过Encounter单场与Day连续遭遇区分局部取胜和跨战斗资源预算。
body.en: It studies decisions shaped jointly by geometry, action economy, timing and rule interactions. Encounter tests local fights; Day links fights to test resource budgeting.

body.zh: Encounter包含20种遭遇，每场景三个种子，比较胜率、剩余生命、存活比例与决策工具成本；Day以五个含3至5场战斗的日程，检查持续生命、法术位和休整安排。
body.en: Encounter evaluates 20 scenarios with three seeds using wins, remaining HP, survival and decision/tool costs. Day contains five sequences of three to five fights with persistent HP, spell slots and rests.

body.zh: 引擎生成的可执行选项界定战斗规则范围，Encounter与Day分别测局部战术及持续资源管理；Day采用五个固定种子日程，与单场轨道保留各自模型设置。
body.en: Executable options define combat scope. Encounter measures local tactics; Day measures persistent resources through five fixed-seed schedules with track-specific model settings.

body.zh: MTG-Causal-RL将万智牌对战包装为Gymnasium环境，使用56张卡池的五种60张套牌；代理接收3077维局部观察，通过合法掩码选择478种离散动作。
body.en: MTG-Causal-RL wraps Magic: The Gathering in Gymnasium, using five 60-card archetypes from a 56-card pool, 3,077-dimensional partial observations and 478 masked discrete actions.

body.zh: 环境显式给出手工结构因果模型、干预预测与因子信用轨迹，使研究同时考察胜负、因果信用分配、策略可审计性及留一套牌迁移。
body.en: A hand-specified structural causal model exposes intervention predictions and factor credit traces, supporting studies of wins, causal credit assignment, auditability and leave-one-archetype-out transfer.

body.zh: 基线比较随机、启发式、masked PPO及因果变体，报告配对bootstrap胜率区间、留出对手差距和因子校准。主结果实际使用两个配对种子、每对手30局。
body.en: Baselines include random, heuristic, masked PPO and causal variants. Metrics cover paired-bootstrap win-rate intervals, held-out opponent gaps and factor calibration; headline experiments use two paired seeds and 30 games per opponent.

body.zh: 主结果规模为两个配对种子、每对手30局，完整建议协议为七种子乘300局；胜率、迁移差距与因子校准分别描述竞争收益、泛化和因果接口一致性。
body.en: Headline results use two paired seeds and 30 games per opponent; the full prescribed protocol uses seven seeds and 300 games. Wins, transfer gaps and calibration describe distinct outcomes.

body.zh: OpenGuanDan提供四人、双队、多轮掼蛋模拟与逐玩家独立接口，支持学习策略、规则机器人及人类交互；每名玩家只见自己的手牌和公开出牌历史。
body.en: OpenGuanDan provides four-player, two-team, multi-round GuanDan with independent player APIs for learned agents, rule bots and human interaction. Players observe their own hand and public play history.

body.zh: 研究集中于隐藏信息、可变出牌组合和合作竞争混合目标，考察大规模信息集及动作空间中的决策学习，并提供人机对局作为额外参照。
body.en: It studies hidden information, variable card combinations and mixed cooperative–competitive objectives, with human matches as an additional reference.

body.zh: 已核验对战让每队由同一策略控制，每个策略配对1000局；报告各轮获得1、2、3奖励的比例及总体胜率，人类比赛结果另列。
body.en: The reviewed matches use one policy per team and 1,000 games per policy pairing, reporting the distribution of one-, two- and three-point round rewards and overall win rate. Human matches are separate.

body.zh: 已登记对战使用同策略队友，主要比较固定组队下的掼蛋竞争水平；多轮奖励分布呈现持续比赛的得分结构，人类对局为另一组参照。
body.en: Reviewed play uses same-policy teammates to compare fixed-team strength. Round rewards describe multi-round scoring, while human matches provide a separate reference.

body.zh: PTCG-Bench在宝可梦集换式卡牌游戏中评估语言模型代理，通过harness将局部状态和历史转为提示，再执行带类型和参数的动作请求。
body.en: PTCG-Bench evaluates LLM agents in the Pokémon Trading Card Game, using a harness to render partial observations and history into prompts and execute typed, parameterized action requests.

body.zh: 资源同时研究固定策略的对战水平、积累经验后的自我改进，以及ReAct与模块化harness设计对成绩的影响，强调代理系统与模型本体共同决定表现。
body.en: It studies fixed-policy playing strength, improvement through accumulated experience and the effects of ReAct and modular harness design on agent performance.

body.zh: 已登记轨道采用固定牌组池和循环赛，主要使用镜像牌组；报告Glicko-2评级及不确定性、两两胜率、重试前非法率和工具调用，非法请求经过验证与重试处理。
body.en: The reviewed track uses a fixed deck pool and round robin, primarily mirror decks, reporting Glicko-2 ratings and uncertainty, pairwise wins, pre-retry invalid rates and tool calls.

body.zh: 固定策略循环赛评价当前对战水平，纵向轨道评价经验积累后的变化；固定牌组池、主要镜像牌组与动作验证规则共同界定harness条件下的表现。
body.en: Fixed-policy tournaments measure current strength; longitudinal trials measure change with experience. Deck pools, mirror matches and validation rules define harness-conditioned performance.

paragraphs.zh: PTCG-Bench在宝可梦集换式卡牌游戏中评估语言模型代理，通过harness将局部状态和历史转为提示，再执行带类型和参数的动作请求。
paragraphs.en: PTCG-Bench evaluates LLM agents in the Pokémon Trading Card Game, using a harness to render partial observations and history into prompts and execute typed, parameterized action requests.

paragraphs.zh: 资源同时研究固定策略的对战水平、积累经验后的自我改进，以及ReAct与模块化harness设计对成绩的影响，强调代理系统与模型本体共同决定表现。
paragraphs.en: It studies fixed-policy playing strength, improvement through accumulated experience and the effects of ReAct and modular harness design on agent performance.

paragraphs.zh: 已登记轨道采用固定牌组池和循环赛，主要使用镜像牌组；报告Glicko-2评级及不确定性、两两胜率、重试前非法率和工具调用，非法请求经过验证与重试处理。
paragraphs.en: The reviewed track uses a fixed deck pool and round robin, primarily mirror decks, reporting Glicko-2 ratings and uncertainty, pairwise wins, pre-retry invalid rates and tool calls.

paragraphs.zh: 固定策略循环赛评价当前对战水平，纵向轨道评价经验积累后的变化；固定牌组池、主要镜像牌组与动作验证规则共同界定harness条件下的表现。
paragraphs.en: Fixed-policy tournaments measure current strength; longitudinal trials measure change with experience. Deck pools, mirror matches and validation rules define harness-conditioned performance.

body.zh: Valet以RECYCLE规则语言统一编码21种传统不完全信息卡牌游戏，覆盖不同文化、玩家数、牌组、胜利条件及隐藏和揭露信息机制。
body.en: Valet encodes 21 traditional imperfect-information card games in RECYCLE, spanning cultures, player counts, decks, victory conditions and information-hiding mechanisms.

body.zh: 资源旨在让算法研究跨游戏比较稳健性，而非围绕单一扑克变体；CardStock实现向玩家提供可见信息和合法选择，基线以确定化处理未知手牌。
body.en: It enables cross-game robustness studies beyond a single poker variant. CardStock supplies visible information and legal options; determinization handles hidden hands in the baseline.

body.zh: 每游戏运行100局全随机与100局首位MCTS对抗随机玩家；每次决策使用10个确定化，每个预算为合法选项数的100倍，报告分数分布、分支因子和局长。
body.en: Each title receives 100 all-random games and 100 first-seat-MCTS games against random players. Decisions use ten determinizations with 100 times the legal-choice count as search budget, reporting scores, branching and duration.

body.zh: 套件采用明确的RECYCLE规则变体，游戏分数按各自规则解释；首位MCTS对随机玩家提供有座位条件的基线，分支因子与局长呈现跨游戏复杂度。
body.en: Explicit RECYCLE variants retain game-specific scores. First-seat MCTS supplies a seat-conditioned baseline; branching and duration characterize cross-game complexity.

body.zh: 该国际象棋基准围绕1118道Lichess谜题研究冻结语言模型的自动提示优化，并用短对局检查谜题提升能否迁移到交互走子。
body.en: This benchmark uses 1,118 Lichess puzzles to study automatic prompt optimization for frozen LLMs, with short gameplay rollouts testing transfer beyond puzzle answers.

body.zh: 研究比较六种优化算法及八个目标模型，利用精确答案与引擎评价构成可更新、低成本的搜索反馈，同时观察优化提示的跨模型泛化。
body.en: It compares six optimization methods and eight target models using exact answers and engine evaluation as renewable, inexpensive feedback, including cross-model prompt transfer.

body.zh: 交互轨道从指定开局与Stockfish对弈，最多接受十个模型棋步，使用Stockfish 18深度20计算每步centipawn regret；基础与优化提示按三个种子配对，非法尝试率另报。
body.en: Gameplay starts from specified openings against Stockfish for at most ten accepted model moves. Stockfish 18 at depth 20 measures centipawn regret, with three paired seeds and separate invalid-attempt rates.

body.zh: 谜题轨道与十步交互轨道分别评价静态答案和短时走子；regret基于每个提示实际到访并接受的棋步，非法率同时描述指令执行可靠性。
body.en: Puzzles and ten-move rollouts separately measure static answers and short gameplay. Regret uses each prompt’s visited, accepted moves; invalid rates describe execution reliability.

body.zh: Concept基准取自桌游的词语猜测机制：模型根据概念图标与线索组合推测目标词，研究如何由有限、间接的属性证据形成最佳解释。
body.en: The Concept benchmark asks models to infer target words from combinations of concept icons and clues, studying abductive reasoning from sparse, indirect attribute evidence.

body.zh: 论文采用最终线索与人类游戏日志构建不同难度的猜词条件，分析模型能否结合多个提示，以及线索逐渐加入时推理如何变化。
body.en: It uses final clue sets and human game logs to vary guessing conditions, examining clue integration and changes as further hints become available.

body.zh: 评价使用找到目标词的比例和猜测次数；所谓动态线索沿原始人类游戏回放，并加入人类错误猜测，观察模型在既定信息序列上的回答。
body.en: Evaluation reports target-found rate and guess count. Dynamic clues replay the original human game and inject recorded wrong guesses, measuring responses to a predetermined information sequence.

body.zh: 最终线索与人类日志回放构成两种离线条件；动态版本沿既定人类线索和错误猜测展开，主要观察模型在逐渐增加的语义证据下如何更新候选词。
body.en: Final clues and human-log replay define two offline conditions. Dynamic trials follow recorded clues and wrong guesses, examining updates as semantic evidence accumulates.

body.zh: DSGBench用统一文字交互组织六种复杂策略游戏，结合不同难度与任务目标，记录决策轨迹并提供细粒度过程评价。
body.en: DSGBench organizes six complex strategic games through a common textual interface, with varied difficulties, objectives, decision traces and fine-grained process evaluation.

body.zh: 研究希望把最终胜负与资源、发展和战术行为联系起来，分析模型策略变化及薄弱环节；跨游戏套件的设计范围大于某一已细化的任务协议。
body.en: It connects outcomes with resource, development and tactical behavior to analyze strategic changes and failures. The suite’s design scope is broader than an individually reviewed protocol.

body.zh: 已核验的StarCraft II任务通过训练、建造、研发、侦察和战斗五类宏动作进行1对1；每场景10局，报告胜率及资源每分钟、支出、人口使用和科技完成统计。
body.en: The reviewed StarCraft II task uses train, build, research, scout and battle macros in 1v1 matches. Ten games per scenario report wins and resource-rate, spending, supply and technology statistics.

body.zh: StarCraft II宏动作协议覆盖资源与生产策略，过程统计记录经济和科技发展；套件其余游戏以及同步、异步和不同对手难度保留各自评价条件。
body.en: StarCraft II macros cover resource and production strategy, with economic and technology diagnostics. Other games, synchronization modes and opponent difficulties retain separate conditions.

body.zh: LudoBench围绕飞行棋的骰子随机性、吃子、安全格与终点推进，构建480个手工单步局面；模型看到规则、棋盘与骰点，选择移动棋子并解释。
body.en: LudoBench contains 480 handcrafted decision spots involving dice, captures, safe squares and finishing in Ludo. Models receive rules, board and die value, select a piece and explain.

body.zh: 十二类行为权衡把发展、完成和风险选择分开，另用相同棋盘加入人格或报复叙事，研究决策偏好及提示敏感性；资源也提供四人模拟器。
body.en: Twelve categories isolate development, finishing and risk choices. Persona and grudge narratives on identical boards test behavioral preferences and prompt sensitivity; a four-player simulator accompanies the spots.

body.zh: 每类40局面，比较模型与有限深度Expectiminimax基线的一致率、各类行为率和回退前非法率；引擎验证动作，失败时可随机选择合法动作。
body.en: Forty spots per category measure agreement with depth-limited Expectiminimax, behavioral rates and pre-fallback invalid rates. The engine validates choices and can fall back to random legal moves.

body.zh: 主评价为480个单步场景，有限深度Expectiminimax提供比较参照；相同棋盘上的中性和报复提示形成配对行为分析，模拟器另支持完整四人比赛。
body.en: The primary evaluation uses 480 single-decision spots with depth-limited Expectiminimax as a reference. Matched narrative prompts analyze behavior; the simulator separately supports full matches.

body.zh: ChessArena把国际象棋完整对弈与状态理解、单步选择及谜题诊断结合，在四种信息模式下比较语言模型与基线，检验规则遵循和策略判断。
body.en: ChessArena combines full chess matches with state understanding, single-move selection and puzzles, comparing LLMs and baselines across four information modes to examine rules and strategy.

body.zh: 研究利用不同观察条件区分棋盘表示、状态跟踪和实际走子表现，并以微调模型展示针对性训练能否改善交互棋力。
body.en: Different observation conditions probe board representation, state tracking and move selection, while a fine-tuned baseline tests whether targeted training improves interactive play.

body.zh: 完整比赛使用FEN及最近十步UCI等模式相关输入，支持UCI和SAN解析；轮换执棋颜色，至多五次非法重试，200步封顶判和，报告胜平负、Glicko及评级偏差。
body.en: Full matches use mode-specific inputs such as FEN and ten recent UCI moves, with UCI/SAN parsing, alternating colors, up to five invalid retries and a 200-move draw cap. Metrics include outcomes and Glicko rating/deviation.

body.zh: 四种模式分别控制棋盘与历史信息，合法步供应另有设置；状态理解、单步和谜题数据提供独立诊断，完整比赛评级由指定对手池与模式拟合。
body.en: Four modes control board and history information, with separate legal-move support. Static diagnostics complement full-match ratings fitted to the chosen pool and mode.

body.zh: GAMA-Bench在八种经典博弈情境中组织多名语言模型玩家互动，提供随游戏参数变化的动态评分，以比较不同规模与结构下的决策行为。
body.en: GAMA-Bench organizes multi-agent LLM interaction in eight classical game-theory scenarios, with dynamic scoring that adapts to game parameters and settings.

body.zh: 研究关注模型的策略稳健性、跨设置泛化和提示方法的效果；参数可变的环境让评价超出固定双人问题，并观察重复互动中的行为调整。
body.en: It studies robustness, generalization across settings and prompting effects beyond fixed two-player tasks, including adaptation during repeated interaction.

body.zh: 代表性的猜均值游戏让十个同模型代理同时在0至100选数，目标为全体均值的三分之二；每局20轮、五次重复，以距均衡0的偏离量及论文归一化得分评价。
body.en: In the reviewed guessing game, ten same-model agents choose numbers from 0 to 100, targeting two-thirds of the group mean. Twenty rounds and five repeats yield equilibrium-deviation and normalized scores.

body.zh: 猜均值任务以均衡偏离描述重复数值决策；八游戏总分按各任务参数与归一化规则组合，呈现不同博弈结构下的策略响应。
body.en: The guessing task measures equilibrium deviation in repeated numerical choices. Eight-game scores combine parameter-dependent mappings to describe responses across game structures.

paragraphs.en: It studies robustness, generalization across settings and prompting effects beyond fixed two-player tasks, including adaptation during repeated interaction.

paragraphs.zh: 代表性的猜均值游戏让十个同模型代理同时在0至100选数，目标为全体均值的三分之二；每局20轮、五次重复，以距均衡0的偏离量及论文归一化得分评价。
paragraphs.en: In the reviewed guessing game, ten same-model agents choose numbers from 0 to 100, targeting two-thirds of the group mean. Twenty rounds and five repeats yield equilibrium-deviation and normalized scores.

paragraphs.zh: 猜均值任务以均衡偏离描述重复数值决策；八游戏总分按各任务参数与归一化规则组合，呈现不同博弈结构下的策略响应。
paragraphs.en: The guessing task measures equilibrium deviation in repeated numerical choices. Eight-game scores combine parameter-dependent mappings to describe responses across game structures.

sources.title: Competing Large Language Models in Multi-Agent Gaming Environments
Competing Large Language Models in Multi-Agent Gaming Environments

body.zh: GUARD使用开放动物移动、人口及基础设施数据生成现实导向的双人矩阵与安全博弈实例，包含反偷猎和基础设施保护等效用建模情境。
body.en: GUARD generates realistic two-player matrix and security-game instances from open animal-movement, demographic and infrastructure data, including anti-poaching and protection scenarios.

body.zh: 研究针对随机博弈实例缺乏真实结构及目标价值数据难获得的问题，提供可调效用函数、游戏参数和预配置集合，分析随机基准的退化性。
body.en: It addresses unrealistic random instances and inaccessible target-value data through configurable utilities, game parameters and preconfigured collections, while analyzing degeneracy in random games.

body.zh: 论文比较纳什与Stackelberg均衡求解算法，包括线性规划、增量策略生成和无遗憾自博弈；依据效用、运行时间、支持集大小及收敛行为比较真实与随机实例。
body.en: Evaluation compares Nash and Stackelberg solvers, including linear programming, incremental strategy generation and no-regret self-play, using utility, runtime, support size and convergence on real and randomized instances.

body.zh: 资源单位为效用矩阵、保护目标及巡逻计划实例，运行时间和收敛刻画求解效率，均衡效用与支持集刻画所得策略结构；各实例保留现实数据和效用假设。
body.en: Units are matrices, protection targets and patrol schedules. Runtime/convergence characterize solver efficiency; equilibrium utility and support characterize strategy under data and utility assumptions.

GUARD: Constructing Realistic Two-Player Matrix and Security Games for Benchmarking Game-Theoretic Algorithms

body.zh: Game Reasoning Arena以OpenSpiel封装棋盘与矩阵游戏，让语言模型与随机、启发式及强化学习代理通过统一文字接口互动；早期版本名为Board Game Arena。
body.en: Game Reasoning Arena wraps OpenSpiel board and matrix games in a common textual interface for LLM, random, heuristic and RL agents. An earlier version was named Board Game Arena.

body.zh: 框架支持API模型、本地部署与分布式执行，研究不同代理的决策结果和推理文本分布；多后端设计服务于系统性、可扩展的游戏比较。
body.en: API models, local deployment and distributed execution support systematic comparisons of decisions and rationale distributions across agent types.

body.zh: 已细化的井字棋任务提供文字棋盘、合法动作和可选历史，代理返回action与reasoning字段；引擎记录回报、终局结果及非法动作，比较时固定种子和模型设置。
body.en: The reviewed Tic-Tac-Toe interface supplies a text board, legal moves and optional history. Agents return action and reasoning fields, with engine returns, outcomes and invalid actions logged under fixed settings.

body.zh: 七游戏运行展示框架的封装范围，井字棋提供已细化的具体接口；推理文本分布描述生成行为，终局回报与动作记录描述引擎内决策结果。
body.en: Seven-game runs describe wrapper coverage, with Tic-Tac-Toe as a detailed interface. Rationale distributions characterize generation; terminal returns and action logs characterize engine decisions.

Game Reasoning Arena: A Framework and Benchmark for Assessing Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models via Game Play

body.zh: GameBench以九种规则环境评估语言代理，包括资源部署、词语选择、棋盘封锁、团队战斗及隐藏阵营互动，玩家使用当前可见状态与环境规定动作。
body.en: GameBench evaluates language agents across nine rule-based environments involving deployment, word choice, board blocking, team combat and hidden alignments, using player-visible states and environment-defined actions.

body.zh: 研究比较基础模型、思维链与Reasoning Via Planning脚手架，观察战略选择、团队配合和身份推断在跨领域游戏中的表现，并以人类作为参照。
body.en: It compares base models, chain-of-thought and Reasoning Via Planning scaffolds across strategic decisions, team coordination and hidden-role inference, with human references.

body.zh: 评价保留各游戏胜负或收益，再以游戏频率倒数重采样及一万次bootstrap拟合加权Bradley–Terry评级和区间；代理状态可在比赛内保留，比赛之间重置。
body.en: Per-game outcomes or payoffs feed inverse-frequency resampling and 10,000 bootstrap weighted Bradley–Terry fits. Agent state can persist within a match and resets between matches.

body.zh: 整体评级汇总九种异质游戏，策略、协作与身份推断子集提供同一批对局的不同观察视图；团队实例允许同代理复制，反映该组队条件下的结果。
body.en: Overall ratings aggregate nine heterogeneous games. Strategic, cooperative and hidden-role subsets are views of the same matches; duplicated teammates define the evaluated team condition.

GameBench: Evaluating Strategic Reasoning Abilities of LLM Agents

body.zh: GTBench构建十种语言驱动博弈任务，涵盖完全与不完全信息、静态与动态、确定性与概率性条件，让模型与其他模型或专用基线竞争。
body.en: GTBench contains ten language-driven game-theory tasks spanning information, temporal and stochastic structures, comparing LLMs against each other and specialized baselines.

body.zh: 研究利用不同游戏类别、均衡与帕累托效率分析策略行为，并比较代码预训练及CoT、ToT推理方法，提供失误类型以补充总体得分。
body.en: It analyzes strategy, equilibrium and Pareto efficiency across game classes, examining code pretraining, CoT/ToT prompting and detailed error profiles.

body.zh: 已核验的重复囚徒困境依据对手历史逐轮选择合作或背叛，对比语言模型、Tit-for-Tat及随机对手，报告累计收益与Normalized Relative Advantage。
body.en: The reviewed iterated Prisoner’s Dilemma uses interaction history to choose cooperation or defection, comparing LLM, Tit-for-Tat and random opponents through cumulative payoff and Normalized Relative Advantage.

body.zh: 重复囚徒困境以历史依赖的累计收益衡量策略，具体得分由收益矩阵与对手决定；套件其他任务分别覆盖完全或不完全、静态或动态等博弈条件。
body.en: The iterated dilemma measures history-dependent payoff under specified opponents and utilities. Other tasks cover separate information, temporal and stochastic conditions.

paragraphs.en: The iterated dilemma measures history-dependent payoff under specified opponents and utilities. Other tasks cover separate information, temporal and stochastic conditions.

sources.title: GTBench: Uncovering the Strategic Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs via Game-Theoretic Evaluations
GTBench: Uncovering the Strategic Reasoning Capabilities of LLMs via Game-Theoretic Evaluations

body.zh: LLM CHESS以工具调用完成整盘国际象棋：模型可查询Unicode棋盘与合法UCI棋步，并通过make_move执行操作；系统不提供既往棋步历史。
body.en: LLM CHESS tests complete chess games through tools for a Unicode board, legal UCI moves and move execution, without supplying prior-move history.

body.zh: 资源将规则遵循与延伸交互中的策略质量一起评估，先对随机对手比较大量模型，再让部分强推理模型挑战不同技能等级引擎以估计棋力。
body.en: It evaluates rule following and move quality during extended interaction, first against random play and then against variable-strength engines for selected reasoning models.

body.zh: 模型固定执黑，每对手等级30局、100回合封顶；报告胜负归一分、违规致负、每步质量分类与局长，明确区分调用轮数、有效性重试和最终弃权。
body.en: Models always play black, with 30 games per opponent level and a 100-move cap. Metrics include normalized wins/losses, instruction forfeits, ply quality and duration under explicit retry rules.

body.zh: 固定执黑、合法动作查询和重试规则构成工具辅助任务条件；引擎技能配置用于估计内部Elo，动作质量、违规致负与胜负共同呈现完整交互表现。
body.en: Black-only play, legal queries and retries define tool-assisted conditions. Engine configurations calibrate internal Elo; move quality, forfeits and outcomes describe interaction.

LLM CHESS: Benchmarking Reasoning and Instruction-Following in LLMs through Chess

body.zh: PokerBench收集11000个翻牌前与翻牌后德州扑克决策场景，由受训扑克玩家参与构建。模型根据牌局叙述和行动历史输出行动及下注或加注金额。
body.en: PokerBench contains 11,000 preflop and postflop poker decision scenarios constructed with trained players. Models output an action and wager amount from a spot description and history.

body.zh: 其核心用途是快速诊断策略选择，并提供监督微调数据；论文同时通过模型间实际比赛检查静态成绩与对战表现的关系。
body.en: It offers a quick diagnostic of strategic choices and data for supervised fine-tuning, with separate gameplay experiments validating the relationship between benchmark scores and match performance.

body.zh: 主要静态评价分别计算Action Accuracy和包括金额的Exact Match，使用按动作抽取的五样例提示与固定解码设置，对照专家标签比较模型和微调变化。
body.en: The primary static evaluation reports Action Accuracy and Exact Match including wager size, using action-stratified five-shot examples and fixed decoding against reference labels.

body.zh: 主要指标描述静态参考行动与金额的一致性；论文另以模型对战验证静态分数与赢局关系，监督微调实验刻画参考决策分布中的学习效果。
body.en: Primary metrics measure agreement with reference actions and amounts. Separate model matches examine score–win relationships, while fine-tuning tests learning within the reference distribution.

body.zh: TMGBench以144类二乘二博弈为原子单元，构造经典与故事化情境，并通过顺序、并行和嵌套结构形成更复杂的策略推理题。
body.en: TMGBench uses 144 classes of 2×2 games as atomic units, creating classic and story-based scenarios and composing them sequentially, in parallel or by nesting.

body.zh: 研究关注博弈类型覆盖、表述变化下的稳健性、理性推理和心智理论问题，试图通过可扩展组合减少对少数熟悉经典游戏的依赖。
body.en: It studies type coverage, robustness to narrative variation, rational reasoning and theory-of-mind questions through extensible game compositions.

body.zh: 评测要求回答均衡或策略组合等问题，复杂组合还可按所有子问题均正确计分；各类故事与结构变体为同一数学博弈提供不同语言和组合条件。
body.en: Models answer equilibrium and strategy-combination questions, with some composite items requiring all subanswers to be correct. Story and structural variants alter language and composition around the underlying games.

body.zh: 条目以博弈描述和问题为输入、均衡或策略答案为输出，经典、故事与组合版本分别控制数学结构、语言表述及任务组织；准确率刻画给定问题的求解表现。
body.en: Items map game descriptions and questions to equilibrium or strategy answers. Classic, story and composite forms control mathematics, wording and organization; accuracy measures solutions.

body.zh: Pgx是用JAX实现、针对GPU与TPU向量化的棋盘游戏模拟器套件，包含国际象棋、将棋、围棋、双陆棋及小型变体，为批量强化学习提供统一状态与合法动作掩码。
body.en: Pgx is a JAX board-game simulator suite vectorized for GPUs and TPUs, including chess, shogi, Go, backgammon and smaller variants, with common state and legal-mask interfaces.

body.zh: 平台研究重点是大规模并行模拟如何加快训练迭代，并用Gumbel AlphaZero展示真实策略学习；吞吐效率与代理棋力分别评价。
body.en: It studies how parallel simulation accelerates training and demonstrates Gumbel AlphaZero learning, separating simulator throughput from policy strength.

body.zh: 已登记五种棋盘变体在共同网络与超参数下训练约1.05亿帧、400轮，评测每步32次搜索；两次运行的成对对局通过BayesElo估计评级，参考模型定为1000分。
body.en: Five reviewed board variants use common networks and hyperparameters for about 105 million frames over 400 iterations, with 32 search simulations per evaluation move. Two runs yield pairwise BayesElo ratings anchored at 1,000.

body.zh: 五种棋盘变体的学习结果按游戏独立拟合BayesElo；平台吞吐实验衡量模拟效率，AlphaZero实验衡量具体训练预算下的策略表现。
body.en: The five variants receive separate BayesElo estimates. Throughput measures simulation efficiency; AlphaZero experiments measure policies learned under specified budgets.

body.zh: Ludii用ludeme这种高层游戏概念描述棋盘规则，将游戏表示为可理解、可扩展的概念结构；引擎可据此生成合法动作并执行完整对局。
body.en: Ludii describes board games through ludemes, high-level game concepts assembled into readable, extensible rule structures. Its engine generates legal moves and executes complete playouts.

body.zh: 平台服务于通用游戏AI、规则设计与游戏历史研究，核心问题是在表达广泛规则的同时兼顾简洁性和计算效率，减少专用引擎间的接口差异。
body.en: It supports general game AI, design and historical research, aiming to combine broad rule expressiveness with concise descriptions and efficient computation.

body.zh: 系统论文主要将Ludii与GDL推理器和Regular Boardgames比较，使用同类游戏的随机完整推演吞吐量等引擎性能指标评估运行效率。
body.en: The system paper primarily compares engine efficiency with a GDL reasoner and Regular Boardgames, including throughput for complete random playouts on shared games.

body.zh: 该系统论文的量化重点是规则引擎效率，随机推演用于比较运行性能；ludeme描述、合法动作生成与完整执行为后续代理研究提供通用基础。
body.en: The paper quantifies rule-engine efficiency through random playout performance. Ludemes, legal-move generation and complete execution provide infrastructure for agent research.

body.zh: MAgIC将两个社会推理游戏和三个博弈论情境组成多智能体竞赛，模型根据角色私有信息、公开讨论及互动历史作出线索、投票和资源决策。
body.en: MAgIC combines two social-deduction games and three game-theory scenarios. Models use role-private information, discussion and history for clues, votes and resource decisions.

body.zh: 研究以认知、适应、理性与协作等维度描述互动，并加入概率图模型提示方法，探索显式建模其他玩家能否改善判断、欺骗与合作行为。
body.en: It examines cognition, adaptability, rationality and collaboration, using probabilistic graphical modeling prompts to test explicit representations of other players.

body.zh: Chameleon与Undercover报告投票、身份推断、欺骗及角色胜率；公共物品游戏采用三人五轮、七种倍增系数和三席轮换，区分个人收益、最高分胜率与公共返还。
body.en: Chameleon and Undercover report voting, deduction, deception and role wins. The public-goods game uses three players, five rounds, seven multipliers and seat rotation, separating individual payoff, winning and communal returns.

body.zh: 隐藏身份诊断按游戏与角色解释，公共物品任务分别记录个人争胜和群体返还；五种情境共同组成社会互动画像，各指标保留其具体收益与信息条件。
body.en: Hidden-role diagnostics are game/role-specific; public goods separates individual winning and communal return. Five scenarios form an interaction profile with distinct information and payoffs.

body.zh: Agent Island是七名不同模型参与的淘汰与陪审团游戏，代理通过私聊、公开陈述和投票争取生存，最终由淘汰者在候选决赛者间投票。
body.en: Agent Island is a seven-model elimination and jury game. Agents use private chats, public pitches and votes to survive, with eliminated players selecting the eventual winner.

body.zh: 资源以随对手变化的合作、冲突和说服替代固定题库，研究动态竞赛能否保持评测区分度，并利用完整游戏日志分析投票与模型偏好。
body.en: It replaces fixed questions with adaptive cooperation, conflict and persuasion, studying dynamic discrimination and using game logs to analyze voting and model preferences.

body.zh: 论文记录999局、49种模型，以获胜频率和Bayesian Plackett–Luce技能后验区间排名；匿名名字、随机抽样、发言顺序和随机平票处理控制部分位置因素。
body.en: The paper records 999 games with 49 models, reporting win frequency and Bayesian Plackett–Luce skill intervals. Anonymization, random sampling, speaking order and tie breaking control some positional effects.

body.zh: Plackett–Luce技能由给定模型池的动态对局拟合，日志同时支持投票与偏好分析；发布资源以游戏记录和分析数据为主，描述完整淘汰与陪审团机制。
body.en: Plackett–Luce skill is fitted to the model pool’s dynamic games. Released logs and analysis data also support voting and preference studies of elimination and jury mechanics.

body.zh: Avalon-ToM-Bench从阿瓦隆的非对称信息机制构建视角受限问题，要求模型判断角色知识、动机及相应推断或行动陈述，而非控制完整游戏。
body.en: Avalon-ToM-Bench derives perspective-constrained questions from Avalon’s asymmetric information, asking models about role knowledge, motives, inferences and actions rather than complete gameplay.

body.zh: 其二乘二分类将认识与动机推理分别交叉推断与行动，试图区分规则知识缺口和更细粒度的心智状态理解；论文还分析隐藏表示与生成答案的差异。
body.en: A 2×2 taxonomy crosses epistemic/motivational reasoning with inference/action, distinguishing rule knowledge from mental-state reasoning and comparing hidden representations with generated answers.

body.zh: 数据包含97个场景、408条二元判断，按子能力报告准确率、macro-F1及宏平均；规则理解对照和线性探针、激活干预提供额外机制诊断。
body.en: Ninety-seven scenarios contain 408 binary judgments, scored through per-ability accuracy, macro-F1 and macro averages, alongside rule-comprehension controls, linear probes and activation interventions.

body.zh: 人工问题采用明确的角色视角与信息权限；二元判断提供细粒度离线诊断，规则理解、生成答案和隐藏表征分析分别描述知识、表达与内部表示。
body.en: Human-crafted questions specify role perspectives and permissions. Binary judgments, rule controls, generated answers and hidden-state analyses describe knowledge, expression and representation.

body.zh: GPTNT基于Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes，让拆弹员读取炸弹视觉界面、手册专家读取说明，两者通过消息交流，在倒计时结束前共同拆除模块。
body.en: GPTNT uses Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes: a Defuser sees the bomb, an Expert sees the manual, and they exchange messages to disarm modules before a live countdown expires.

body.zh: 研究将信息不对称、沟通歧义与实时压力放在同一任务中，比较模型单独理解说明和异步协作执行时的差距，并分析状态跟踪与错误恢复。
body.en: It combines asymmetric information, ambiguous communication and time pressure, contrasting manual understanding with asynchronous collaboration and examining state tracking and recovery.

body.zh: 交互轨道使用十个固定难度2或3的任务，报告pass@1、解决模块数及超时和错误爆炸；实时异步与暂停计时的同步模式分别呈现。
body.en: Ten fixed level-2/3 missions report pass@1, modules solved, timeouts and strikeouts. Real-time asynchronous and paused-clock synchronous modes are evaluated separately.

body.zh: 异步模式保留实时计算与沟通开销，同步模式暂停计时以分析能力组成；ManualVQA提供说明理解的离线参照，交互轨道以成功拆弹为任务终点。
body.en: Asynchronous play includes computation and communication time; synchronous play pauses the clock for analysis. ManualVQA supplies offline manual comprehension, while interaction targets defusal.

body.zh: M3-BENCH以24种混合动机游戏评估语言代理的社会行为，同时保留行动、推理和沟通内容，观察最终收益之外的互动过程。
body.en: M3-BENCH evaluates LLM social behavior in 24 mixed-motive games, retaining actions, reasoning and communication to examine interaction processes beyond final payoff.

body.zh: 框架分为行为轨迹、推理过程与沟通内容三种视角，研究内部分析、对外交流和实际行动是否一致，以及模型能否将推理转化为有效互惠。
body.en: Behavioral, reasoning and communication analyses examine consistency between deliberation, speech and action, including whether models translate reasoning into effective reciprocity.

body.zh: 已细化的十轮重复困境先交流再选择合作或背叛，依据动作轨迹计算合作、条件互惠、报复、宽恕和末轮背叛；双方知道有限时限。
body.en: The reviewed ten-round dilemma permits communication before cooperation/defection. Action trajectories yield cooperation, conditional reciprocity, retaliation, forgiveness and final-round defection under a known horizon.

body.zh: 十轮困境是24游戏中的已细化实例，行为统计直接取自动作序列；推理过程与沟通评分提供额外分析视角，具体配对与评委设置决定其比较范围。
body.en: The ten-round dilemma is a detailed example among 24 games. Action-derived statistics complement reasoning and communication analyses, whose comparisons depend on pairings and judges.

body.zh: MINDGAMES基于TextArena统一四种博弈：Colonel Blotto、重复囚徒困境、Codenames和Secret Mafia，提供交互接口、TrueSkill排名及完整轨迹记录。

body.zh: Multicultural Spyfall让四名非间谍与一名间谍围绕隐藏地点或食物问答：非间谍知道实体并寻找间谍，间谍则试图推断实体且避免暴露。
body.en: Multicultural Spyfall uses four non-spies and one spy in question-based play about a hidden location or food. Non-spies know the entity and seek the spy; the spy infers it while avoiding detection.

body.zh: 研究把文化实体和非英语表达融入动态社会推理，观察语言熟练度、本地知识、规则遵循与策略完整性如何共同影响多模型竞争。
body.en: It introduces culturally specific entities and non-English interaction to study the joint effects of language proficiency, local knowledge, rule following and strategy.

body.zh: 前五轮进行问答，后五轮允许猜实体和投票，动作按阶段输出JSON；按角色、语言和文化条件统计胜率及Bradley–Terry评级，并处理格式失败。
body.en: Five question rounds precede five rounds permitting guesses and votes, with phase-specific JSON actions. Evaluation reports role-, language- and culture-conditioned wins and Bradley–Terry ratings.

body.zh: 五人十轮规则将文化实体、语言与角色权限结合；分角色和分文化结果呈现知识、表达与社会推理在这一具体信息结构中的共同作用。
body.en: Five-player, ten-round rules combine cultural entities, language and role permissions. Stratified results reflect knowledge, expression and social reasoning within this information structure.

body.zh: ParliamentBench以Secret Hitler为基础组织五人政府形成与隐藏阵营博弈：玩家提名总理、表决政府、执行政策，并在阶段间讨论。
body.en: ParliamentBench implements five-player government formation and hidden-alignment play based on Secret Hitler, with chancellor nominations, government votes, policy enactment and discussion.

body.zh: 研究通过模型互战、人机对战和在线游戏参照，分析信息不对称下的推理、说服与欺骗一致性，关注玩家是否能长期维持隐藏身份叙事。
body.en: Model, human and online-game comparisons examine reasoning, persuasion and deceptive consistency under asymmetric information, including sustained hidden-role behavior.

body.zh: 已登记配置为三自由派、一法西斯及希特勒，政府投票前与政策后各一轮随机顺序发言；评价阵营胜率、身份识别、欺骗保持、政府通过及局势影响。
body.en: The reviewed setup has three liberals, one fascist and Hitler, with randomized discussions before votes and after policies. Metrics include faction wins, role recognition, deception retention, approval and game-state impact.

body.zh: 五人角色结构、讨论顺序与指定对手构成实验版本；身份识别、欺骗保持和局势影响为论文定义的辅助诊断，与阵营胜率共同描述完整比赛行为。
body.en: Five-player roles, discussion order and opponents define the version. Paper-defined role recognition, deception retention and impact diagnostics complement faction wins.

body.zh: Social Gym将21种社会游戏组织成多智能体锦标赛，以规则确定的胜负评价协作、协商和对手适应；SPaRTan在游戏后反思轨迹，形成可迁移策略手册。
body.en: Social Gym organizes 21 social games into multi-agent tournaments with rule-decided outcomes. SPaRTan reflects on trajectories to produce transferable playbooks for subsequent games.

body.zh: 研究一方面比较不同模型与角色的社会推理差异，另一方面检查无需更新权重的自博弈、反思及迁移循环能否改善较弱角色表现。
body.en: It compares model- and role-dependent social reasoning and tests whether training-free self-play, reflection and transfer improve weaker roles.

body.zh: 已细化的狼人杀由有限状态机调度发言、投票和夜间技能，40轮封顶；村民清除狼人获胜、狼人达到人数平衡获胜，报告角色胜率与Bradley–Terry拟合Elo。
body.en: The reviewed Werewolves task uses finite-state speech, votes and night actions with a forty-turn cap. Village elimination and wolf parity determine wins, feeding role rates and Bradley–Terry Elo.

body.zh: 狼人杀是21游戏中的一个角色化实例，Elo由指定锦标赛池拟合；SPaRTan的手册效果按基础模型、角色及后续游戏分别观察。
body.en: Werewolves is one role-conditioned instance among 21 games. Elo is fitted to the tournament pool; playbook effects are examined by model, role and subsequent game.

body.zh: Convention Gap利用Hanabi记录研究伙伴行动中超出字面提示的信息：玩家只见他人手牌及自己的提示，从提示选择与可见牌推断安全出牌。
body.en: Convention Gap analyzes Hanabi logs for information conveyed beyond literal hints. Players see others’ cards and hints about their own, using hint choices and visible cards to judge safe plays.

body.zh: 研究提出隐式约定诊断，将公平洗牌与只使用字面信息的玩家作为理论参照，比较人类同伴、人机及不同推理层级AI配对。
body.en: It proposes a diagnostic of implicit conventions, using fair shuffling and literal-information play as a theoretical reference across human, mixed and AI partnerships.

body.zh: 指标等于根据字面提示和可见牌精确计算的失败概率，减去实际出牌失败率；论文利用记录估计该差值并比较伙伴和行动类别。
body.en: The metric subtracts observed play-failure rate from the failure probability computed exactly from literal hints and visible cards, comparing partners and play categories in logs.

body.zh: 该方法对Hanabi记录进行事后诊断，非零差值表明伙伴选择传递了超出字面的信息；差值以失败概率百分点表达，理论解释依赖公平洗牌及字面信息参照。
body.en: This retrospective Hanabi diagnostic expresses extra-literal information through a failure-probability gap, interpreted under fair shuffling and a literal-information reference.

body.zh: Game Arena是Kaggle的开放竞争评测平台，首批包含国际象棋、双人无限注德州扑克和八人狼人杀，模型以受控接口直接比赛并保留轨迹。
body.en: Kaggle Game Arena is an open competitive evaluation platform initially covering chess, heads-up no-limit Hold’em and eight-player Werewolf, with controlled interfaces and recorded trajectories.

body.zh: 研究以动态对手竞争补充静态题库，同时针对确定性棋盘、隐藏牌下注及多人社会博弈设计不同统计方法，避免单一总分掩盖任务差别。
body.en: It supplements static tests with evolving competition and distinct statistics for deterministic board play, hidden-card betting and multi-player social interaction.

body.zh: 国际象棋每配对40局，报告Bradley–Terry Elo；扑克每配对20000手、镜像发牌与换位，以BB/100和分段bootstrap估计收益；狼人杀以GTE分解角色贡献。
body.en: Chess uses 40 games per pair and Bradley–Terry Elo. Poker uses 20,000 mirrored, seat-swapped hands per pair with BB/100 and block bootstrap. Werewolf uses GTE to decompose role contributions.

body.zh: 三游戏保留各自观察、非法动作规则和统计单位，内部评级由所选对手池拟合；扑克分段收益与狼人角色贡献分别呈现隐藏信息和角色不对称条件下的表现。
body.en: Three games retain distinct observations, validity rules and units. Internal ratings depend on the pool; poker returns and Werewolf contributions describe hidden information and role asymmetry.

body.zh: 狼人杀信念变化基准从语言模型对局中标注怀疑与指控消息，让村民观察者在阅读一条消息前后报告对其他玩家身份的信念。
body.en: The Werewolf belief-shift benchmark annotates suspicion and accusation messages from LLM games, asking village observers to report role beliefs before and after individual messages.

body.zh: 研究把指控内容与指控者可信度分开，观察模型是否因既有信任而接受错误指控，以及更强模型能否结合历史识别真实狼人。
body.en: It separates accusation content from source trust, studying acceptance of misleading claims and whether stronger models integrate history to identify wolves.

body.zh: 论文评估1224条注释消息和40种开放权重配置，按真实阵营、受指控者及指控者信任分层统计信念与变化，并提供均值的95%区间。
body.en: Evaluation covers 1,224 annotated messages and 40 open-weight configurations, stratifying beliefs and shifts by true alignment, target and accuser trust, with 95% intervals for means.

body.zh: 离线观察者读取已记录消息并报告主观身份信念，分层变化量描述对内容与来源的响应；原对局背景为诊断提供角色真值和既有信任条件。
body.en: Offline observers report subjective role beliefs from recorded messages. Stratified shifts describe responses to content and source, using original roles and prior trust as context.

body.zh: Among Us sandbox以文字环境重建船员与内鬼的行动和会议：船员执行任务并识别内鬼，内鬼通过击杀、伪装与讨论阻止任务完成。
body.en: The Among Us sandbox reimplements crew and impostor actions and meetings in text. Crewmates complete tasks and identify impostors; impostors use kills, fake tasks and discussion to obstruct them.

body.zh: 研究让欺骗作为长期游戏目标的策略自然出现，并将生成欺骗的表现与检测欺骗的能力分开，另用激活探针和稀疏自编码器分析模型表征。
body.en: It lets deception emerge instrumentally from game goals and separates deceptive play from deception detection, including activation probes and sparse-autoencoder analyses.

body.zh: 已核验配置为五船员、两内鬼、50步上限，会议三轮讨论后投票；角色胜率与Deception Elo采用1000次bootstrap，检测探针的AUROC另行报告。

body.zh: LLM-Coordination研究纯合作条件下的语言代理，包含四个交互协调游戏与198道CoordQA选择题，以环境理解、他人信念与联合规划分析表现。
body.en: LLM-Coordination studies pure cooperation through four interactive coordination games and 198 CoordQA questions, examining environment understanding, partner beliefs and joint planning.

body.zh: 研究比较显式ToM推理与其他决策组件，并考察零样本陌生伙伴配对，区分依靠环境信息的协作与依靠队友信念和意图推断的协作。
body.en: It compares explicit ToM reasoning and decision components, including zero-shot partnerships, distinguishing environmental coordination from reasoning about teammates’ intentions.

body.en: Reviewed tasks include two-agent graph capture and generator activation followed by escape from a pursuer. Fixed layouts and starts use three trials per setting, reporting success and completion turns.

body.zh: 交互轨道使用图与房间抽象，三次重复呈现固定布局中的协作结果；CoordQA的静态答案提供环境理解、ToM和联合规划的补充诊断。

body.zh: LLMsPark以经典博弈论游戏组织多模型交互，比较决策策略与社会行为，并提供公开排名；论文对15种商业及开放模型进行交叉评测。
body.en: LLMsPark organizes multi-model interaction in classical game-theory settings, comparing strategies and social behavior through public rankings and cross-evaluation of 15 commercial and open models.

body.zh: 平台希望从互动轨迹而非单一问答分数观察策略差异。已细化的Nim要求玩家依据石堆状态轮流取石，选择一堆及正数个石子，以取走最后一颗获胜。
body.en: It studies behavioral differences through interaction rather than isolated answers. In the reviewed Nim task, players choose a pile and positive removal count, winning by taking the last stone.

body.zh: 系统记录胜、平、负并更新Elo，初始1000分、K值32；Nim输入包含当前石堆、规则和历史，合法行动与终局由引擎判断。
body.en: The system records outcomes and updates Elo from 1,000 with K=32. Nim supplies piles, rules and history, with engine-defined legal moves and terminal outcomes.

body.zh: Nim的规则与Elo更新已明确，初始石堆和配对清单决定具体比赛实例；平台总榜描述多模型交叉评测，当前细化任务提供其中一个规则驱动的观察窗口。
body.en: Nim rules and Elo updates are specified; pile and pairing manifests define match instances. The overall leaderboard aggregates cross-model evaluation; this task provides one detailed view.

body.zh: MultiAgentBench面向多样交互场景评估语言模型团队，基于MARBLE编排代理协作与竞争，比较星形、链形、树形和图式沟通结构。
body.en: MultiAgentBench evaluates LLM teams across diverse interactive scenarios through MARBLE, comparing star, chain, tree and graph communication structures.

body.zh: 研究将任务完成与协作质量分开，使用里程碑指标，并比较群体讨论和认知规划；游戏相关实例是Minecraft中按目标结构描述协同建造。
body.en: It separates task completion from collaboration quality through milestones, group discussion and cognitive planning. Its game-related example is collaborative Minecraft structure construction.

body.zh: 建造轨道包含100个VillagerAgent结构，经11种Mineflayer高层工具挖掘、放置和移动；主设定20次迭代、最多五次沟通迭代，以方块类型、坐标和朝向命中率计分。
body.en: The building track uses 100 VillagerAgent structures and eleven Mineflayer tools. The main setup allows 20 iterations and five communication iterations, scoring correct block type, position and orientation.

body.zh: 建造轨道依赖高层工具与目标结构，方块命中率描述环境完成度；沟通和规划的评委分数描述协作过程，两类指标共同呈现有界Minecraft建造。
body.en: High-level tools and target structures define building. Block accuracy measures completion; judge ratings describe communication and planning, jointly characterizing bounded Minecraft construction.

body.zh: AdaSociety将可变化的物理世界与显式社会连接结合，代理行动会扩展状态、动作与后续任务；平台提供三种小游戏展示不同社会结构。
body.en: AdaSociety combines adaptive physical worlds with explicit social connections. Actions can expand states, actions and subsequent tasks; three mini-games illustrate different social structures.

body.zh: 研究社会关系如何改变收益分享、信息获取与资源协作，并比较RL和语言模型是否能够利用这些结构提升个人或群体收益。
body.en: It studies how social relations affect reward sharing, information access and resource cooperation, comparing whether RL and LLM agents exploit these structures.

body.zh: 已细化的Contract先轮流组建收益共享组织，再由互补工种同步移动、采集和制作；组内均分回报，以个人与组织收益为主，公平性与网络统计补充。
body.en: The reviewed Contract game first forms reward-sharing groups, then uses complementary roles for synchronous movement, gathering and crafting. Individual and group rewards are primary, supplemented by fairness and network statistics.

body.zh: 人数、资源、结盟cN和物理阶段T由配置定义，Easy与Hard分别评价；Contract结果对应收益共享组与互补工种的社会物理结构。
body.en: Population, resources, formation cN and physical horizon T are configured, with separate Easy/Hard evaluation. Contract results concern reward-sharing groups and complementary roles.

body.zh: AmongAgents用文本模拟Among Us的房间、任务、监控与会议，四名船员完成任务或投出内鬼，一名内鬼通过击杀、伪装任务及通风阻止他们。
body.en: AmongAgents simulates Among Us rooms, tasks, cameras and meetings in text. Four crewmates complete tasks or expel one impostor, who obstructs them through kills, fake tasks and vents.

body.zh: 研究观察语言代理在不完全信息下如何依据局部事件行动，并改变船员与内鬼的策略和人格组合，分析讨论、怀疑及胜负形成过程。
body.en: It studies decisions from local evidence under hidden information, varying crew/impostor strategies and personality configurations and analyzing discussion and outcomes.

body.zh: 每名船员有短、普通、长任务各一项；全随机、全语言模型、仅船员模型及仅内鬼模型四条件各20局，报告角色胜率、任务完成与超时，发言类别另由模型标注。
body.en: Each crewmate receives three task types. Four conditions—random, all-LLM, LLM-crew and LLM-impostor—use twenty games each, reporting role wins, completion and timeout; speech categories are separately model-annotated.

body.zh: 房间图与顺序文本动作界定重实现版本，四种控制条件各20局；角色胜负、任务进度和发言类别分别描述比赛结果、执行行为及语言表现。
body.en: Room graphs and sequential text actions define the reimplementation, with twenty games per control. Wins, task progress and speech labels describe outcomes, execution and language.

body.zh: AvalonBench将阿瓦隆的角色私密信息、公开讨论、队伍提案、投票、任务与刺杀整合为语言代理环境，让好人与坏人阵营争取各自胜利。
body.en: AvalonBench combines private roles, discussion, team proposals, voting, quests and assassination in an Avalon environment for competing good and evil teams.

body.zh: 资源提供确定性规则机器人及按角色定制提示的ReAct代理，研究推断、欺骗和协商如何共同影响动态阶段中的决策。
body.en: It supplies deterministic rule bots and role-specific ReAct agents to study how inference, deception and negotiation shape phase-dependent decisions.

body.zh: 模型读取自己可见的角色信息、讨论与历史摘要，输出发言和阶段离散选择；评价按好人、坏人角色分别统计对规则机器人的胜率，并保留座位和提示条件。
body.en: Models receive visible role information, discussion and summaries and produce utterances or phase-specific choices. Evaluation reports good/evil win rates against rule bots with seat and prompting conditions retained.

body.zh: 好坏阵营有不同信息和胜利条件，角色胜率在具体座位与提示条件下比较；完整对局综合呈现策略、讨论、推断及阶段动作执行。
body.en: Good and evil have distinct information and objectives, with wins conditioned on seats and prompts. Complete games combine strategy, discussion, inference and phase execution.

body.zh: Codenames基准让密码大师用一个词和数量连接多个己方目标，猜词者依据线索选择词或结束回合；两种角色看到不同的颜色分配信息。
body.en: The Codenames benchmark pairs a spymaster supplying one-word, numbered clues with a guesser selecting words or ending the turn. Roles have different access to word-color assignments.

body.zh: 研究将词语关联与伙伴理解结合，比较同模型和部分跨模型搭档，并与词向量方法对照，观察角色差异及团队兼容性。
body.en: It combines semantic association with partner understanding, comparing same-model and some mixed-model pairings against word-embedding approaches to examine roles and compatibility.

body.zh: 论文包含单队合作和双队竞争实验；已登记双队配置每种组合100局、种子0至99，同队两角色使用同一模型，按红蓝队胜率计分，选中刺客立即输局。
body.en: The paper includes single-team and two-team experiments. Reviewed competition uses 100 games per combination with seeds 0–99 and same-model teammates, reporting red/blue wins with immediate loss on the assassin.

body.zh: 单队实验按合作效率观察搭档组合，双队实验按对抗胜负评价。跨模型队友结果主要来自单队部分，角色表现同时包含语义知识与对线索意图的判断。
body.en: Single-team experiments examine cooperative efficiency and pairings; two-team experiments measure competitive outcomes. Mixed-model results mainly come from the former, combining semantic knowledge and clue-intent judgments.

paragraphs.zh: Codenames基准让密码大师用一个词和数量连接多个己方目标，猜词者依据线索选择词或结束回合；两种角色看到不同的颜色分配信息。
paragraphs.en: The Codenames benchmark pairs a spymaster supplying one-word, numbered clues with a guesser selecting words or ending the turn. Roles have different access to word-color assignments.

paragraphs.zh: 研究将词语关联与伙伴理解结合，比较同模型和部分跨模型搭档，并与词向量方法对照，观察角色差异及团队兼容性。
paragraphs.en: It combines semantic association with partner understanding, comparing same-model and some mixed-model pairings against word-embedding approaches to examine roles and compatibility.

paragraphs.zh: 论文包含单队合作和双队竞争实验；已登记双队配置每种组合100局、种子0至99，同队两角色使用同一模型，按红蓝队胜率计分，选中刺客立即输局。
paragraphs.en: The paper includes single-team and two-team experiments. Reviewed competition uses 100 games per combination with seeds 0–99 and same-model teammates, reporting red/blue wins with immediate loss on the assassin.

paragraphs.zh: 单队实验按合作效率观察搭档组合，双队实验按对抗胜负评价。跨模型队友结果主要来自单队部分，角色表现同时包含语义知识与对线索意图的判断。
paragraphs.en: Single-team experiments examine cooperative efficiency and pairings; two-team experiments measure competitive outcomes. Mixed-model results mainly come from the former, combining semantic knowledge and clue-intent judgments.

body.zh: LLMArena提供七种动态多智能体游戏，以可扩展文字接口组织模型互动；任务涉及空间、数字、风险、策略与交流，排行榜采用TrueSkill。
body.en: LLMArena supplies seven dynamic multi-agent games through an extensible textual interface, spanning spatial, numerical, risk, strategic and communication demands, with TrueSkill rankings.

body.zh: 研究比较不同类型和规模模型及人类表现，尤其分析对手建模与团队协作。具体游戏规则将这些综合需求转成可执行行动与环境收益。
body.en: It compares model types, scales and humans, emphasizing opponent modeling and teamwork, with rules mapping these combined demands to executable actions and rewards.

body.zh: 已细化Hanabi为双人双颜色、数字1至5、每人两张牌、初始三信息token；代理见伙伴手牌与自身提示，通过出牌、弃牌和颜色数字提示合作，报告平均烟花团队分数。
body.en: The reviewed Hanabi variant uses two players, two colors, ranks 1–5, two-card hands and three initial information tokens. Agents play, discard or hint using partner cards and own hints; the metric is mean team fireworks score.

body.zh: 这一缩小Hanabi版本有自己的牌组与信息预算，作为七游戏中的合作实例登记；总榜评分与该环境的平均回报分别反映跨对手竞争和局内团队收益。
body.en: This reduced Hanabi variant has its own deck and information budget and forms one cooperative example among seven games. Overall ratings and environment return describe different aggregation levels.

body.zh: Melting Pot Contest 2023利用混合动机环境评估代理与陌生伙伴合作，参赛策略在自身回报与其他玩家行动的相互依赖中形成行为。
body.en: The 2023 Melting Pot Contest evaluates cooperation with unfamiliar partners in mixed-motive environments, where individual returns depend on other players’ behavior.

body.zh: 竞赛关注社会泛化，以留出伙伴和场景检验训练种群中的策略能否适应新组合；论文汇总竞赛设计、提交方案及合作智能评价经验。
body.en: It focuses on social generalization through held-out partners and scenarios, reporting contest design, submissions and lessons for cooperative-intelligence evaluation.

body.zh: 已展开的Clean Up让代理在采集资源与清洁公共河流间分配行动，使用局部RGB及允许状态；主指标为焦点代理人均回报，相对于基线最好与最差回报归一化。
body.en: The reviewed Clean Up task balances harvesting and river cleaning from local RGB and permitted state. Focal per-capita return is normalized relative to baseline best and worst returns.

body.zh: 公开验证包含clean_up_2至8，最终比赛使用另外的留出伙伴；当前描述以可核验公开配置和论文评分为范围，保留局部观察与官方场景版本的区别。
body.en: Public validation includes clean_up_2–8, while final evaluation uses additional held-out partners. This description covers verifiable public configurations and paper scoring, with version and visibility conditions retained.

body.zh: Multi-Agent Balderdash让语言模型为生僻词编写可信的虚构定义，再在混合候选中投票识别真实含义，其他玩家选择假定义即可形成欺骗收益。
body.en: Multi-Agent Balderdash asks LLMs to invent plausible definitions for obscure words and then identify the true meaning among mixed candidates, earning deceptive rewards when others select their inventions.

body.zh: 研究把创造性生成、真假语义判断和历史条件下的策略放在同一中央游戏引擎中，比较多种模型产生可信语言及识破虚构的表现。
body.en: A centralized engine combines creative generation, semantic judgments and history-conditioned strategy to compare plausible language production and detection of invented definitions.

body.zh: 评价分别报告真实定义比例、欺骗比例、正确猜测比例与游戏得分，语义等价由独立评审模型判断；词表、随机种子和历史窗口构成比较条件。
body.en: Evaluation separates True Definition Ratio, Deception Ratio, Correct Guess Ratio and game scores. A judge model assesses semantic equivalence; word decks, seeds and history windows define conditions.

body.zh: 生词知识会影响真假定义判断，评审模型影响语义匹配；因此定义质量、骗取选择和识别真义分别提供语言生成、社会影响与知识推理的证据。
body.en: Rare-word knowledge affects definition judgments and the judge affects semantic matching. Definition quality, induced selections and true-meaning identification supply distinct evidence about generation, influence and knowledge.

body.zh: Welfare Diplomacy将外交棋的军事征服目标改为一般和福利奖励，玩家通过私下协商、移动支援及建造解散命令，权衡武装投入与国内福利。
body.en: Welfare Diplomacy turns Diplomacy into a general-sum welfare game. Players negotiate privately and issue movement, support, build and disband orders, balancing military investment with domestic welfare.

body.zh: 资源研究在保留军事威胁和被利用风险时如何促成互惠，提供开源引擎规则变体及零样例语言代理，并检验去军事化等联合政策。
body.en: It studies reciprocity under military threats and exploitation risks through an open engine variant and zero-shot LLM agents, including joint policies such as demilitarization.

body.zh: 实验固定结束年限，报告累计福利点与社会福利，并分别进行自博弈和指定剥削策略测试，以同时观察集体收益及其面对策略性对手的稳健性。
body.en: Experiments fix the end year and report cumulative and social welfare, separating self-play from specified exploiter tests to examine collective returns and robustness.

body.zh: 福利变体按多方累计福利评价，原版按征服目标评价，两套规则有各自收益含义；可利用性结果对应论文实际测试的对手策略集合。
body.en: The welfare variant measures multi-party welfare while standard Diplomacy uses conquest objectives. Exploitability results are relative to the opponent policies actually tested.

body.zh: ZSC-Eval 将零样本协作评测组织为伙伴生成、筛选和配对测试；智能体部署时面对训练中未共同优化的伙伴，覆盖 Overcooked 与 Google Research Football。
body.en: ZSC-Eval organizes zero-shot coordination around partner generation, selection and cross-play in Overcooked and Google Research Football.

body.zh: 行为偏好奖励产生不同协作风格，Best-Response Diversity 筛选伙伴，研究重点是伙伴分布变化后的协作泛化，而非仅与自身副本取得高回报。
body.en: Behavior-preferring rewards generate partner styles, and Best-Response Diversity selects them to study generalization beyond self-play partners.

body.zh: 团队回报与 Best-Response Proximity 衡量配合表现，后者相对最佳回应参照归一化；布局、伙伴检查点和角色交换共同决定比较条件。
body.en: Team return and Best-Response Proximity measure coordination relative to best-response references, conditional on layouts, checkpoints and role assignments.

body.zh: 具体协作单元采用 Overcooked-AI 布局、同步离散动作与固定伙伴池；完整工具包还包含足球，伙伴分布与最佳回应参照共同定义零样本协作的评价条件。
body.en: The concrete unit uses Overcooked-AI layouts, simultaneous discrete actions and a fixed partner pool; the broader toolkit includes football, with partner distributions and best-response references defining evaluation.

body.zh: Arena 是基于 Unity 的多智能体环境与构建工具包，以不同游戏规则、社会树和五类奖励关系组合合作、竞争及混合互动问题。
body.en: Arena is a Unity platform that combines game rules, social trees and five reward schemes into cooperative, competitive and mixed multi-agent problems.

body.zh: 平台提供五种深度多智能体强化学习基线及参考智能体或队伍种群，研究对象包括队内协作、队间竞争和面对多种对手的稳定表现。
body.en: Five deep MARL baselines and reference agent or team populations support research on cooperation, competition and performance against varied opponents.

body.zh: Crossroads 案例中，各成员通过移动和转向穿过路口；率先全员到达目标的队伍得分，并以回合回报和参考种群排名评价策略。
body.en: In Crossroads, agents move and turn across a junction; the first complete team wins. Evaluation uses episodic reward and reference-population ranking.

body.zh: Crossroads 给出具体的团队竞赛协议；完整平台另含多种 Unity 游戏。正文采用三十五款口径，图示场景标签保留各自名称，参考种群构成排名的比较背景。
body.en: Crossroads supplies a concrete team-race protocol within the larger Unity platform. The text uses a thirty-five-game count, while illustrated scene labels retain their names and reference populations define rankings.

body.zh: ARC-AGI-3 让智能体进入没有明示规则与目标的抽象回合制环境，从离散视觉画面和行动反馈中探索操作含义，逐步完成多关任务。
body.en: ARC-AGI-3 places agents in abstract turn-based environments without explicit rules or goals, requiring discovery through visual observations and action feedback.

body.zh: 核心问题是面对新环境的适应效率：智能体需要提出规则假设、验证状态转移，再把获得的内部模型用于后续关卡的行动规划。
body.en: It studies adaptive efficiency: agents hypothesize rules, test transitions and apply acquired internal models to later levels.

body.zh: RHAE 将关卡完成与相对人类基线的行动效率结合，先逐关评价再汇总到环境；动作接口包括环境特定按键和坐标选择。
body.en: RHAE combines completion with action efficiency relative to human baselines, aggregating level scores within environments using environment-specific controls.

body.zh: 任务采用简单离散视觉与动作接口，重点是未知规则下的适应与行动效率。公开示例说明交互方式，私有新环境构成独立测试，评分以人类行动基线为参照。
body.en: Simple visual and action interfaces focus measurement on adaptation and action efficiency under unknown rules. Public examples explain interaction; private environments define testing against human action baselines.
