body.zh: CausalGame 以十四类互动模拟情境评估因果思考，智能体主动设计试验、收集观测，并提交最终方案与解释，情境包含选择偏差、测量误差及隐藏混杂。
body.en: CausalGame evaluates causal thinking in fourteen interactive scenarios involving selection bias, measurement error and hidden confounding through experiments and final reports.

body.zh: 研究重点是从相关性中辨认可干预机制；查询工具、候选部署和有限试验预算构成信息获取过程，真实结构因果模型不向智能体公开。
body.en: Agents must distinguish intervenable mechanisms from correlations using query tools and bounded experiments while the structural causal model remains hidden.

body.zh: 已审阅的 Antenna Trap 单元要求选择防御配置，以最终一千架模拟无人机的生存率及阈值成功计分，因果解释评分单独报告。
body.en: The reviewed Antenna Trap unit scores a defensive configuration on survival across 1,000 simulated drones, with threshold success and causal explanations reported separately.

body.zh: 天线陷阱是十四类情境中的具体干预实验，防御配置、试验预算和生存阈值定义其评价单位；其他情境分别体现选择偏差、测量误差或隐藏混杂机制。
body.en: Antenna Trap is one intervention experiment with its own defensive design, budget and survival threshold; other scenarios instantiate selection bias, measurement error or hidden confounding.

body.zh: ClassicLogic 围绕数独、KenKen、Kakuro 与 Futoshiki 四类经典逻辑谜题建立显式分层知识库，把复杂解题策略表示为基础规则的组合。
body.en: ClassicLogic supplies hierarchical knowledge bases for Sudoku, KenKen, Kakuro and Futoshiki, expressing complex solving strategies as compositions of elementary rules.

body.zh: 研究对象是组合泛化：模型是否能从基础规则形成多步策略，并把已知知识应用到需要新组合、且难度经过验证的谜题。
body.en: It studies compositional generalization from basic rules to multistep strategies and novel combinations at validated difficulty levels.

body.zh: 已核验的数独交互使用符号网格或 MNIST 视觉线索，通过 place(row,col,value) 更新棋盘，以困难任务成功率检验策略形成和应用。
body.en: The reviewed Sudoku interaction uses symbolic or MNIST-rendered clues and rule-checked placement actions, measuring success on hard strategy-composition tasks.

body.zh: 完整资源包含四类逻辑谜题，数独提供已审阅的具体行动接口。符号和视觉线索形成两种观察条件，困难任务以层级知识组合所要求的策略深度组织。
body.en: The resource spans four puzzle families, with Sudoku providing the reviewed action interface. Symbolic and visual clues define observation conditions, and difficult tasks exercise hierarchical strategy composition.

body.zh: DiG-bench 包含七十个独立字符串游戏；每个游戏的状态变换规则和各关胜利条件均未知，智能体必须通过操作、观察与试验发现规律。
body.en: DiG-bench contains seventy independent string games with unknown transformation rules and level goals that agents discover through interaction.

body.zh: 它把科学发现中的提出概括和实验检验转化为可控游戏任务；接口返回字符串、合法动作、关卡、生命与步数，并支持探索和生存模式。
body.en: The benchmark operationalizes generalization and experimental testing through string states, legal actions, levels, lives and exploration or survival modes.

body.zh: 评测按七个难度层比较通关比例和行动消耗，连续关卡检验规则是否真正被掌握；难度分层依赖所测模型的实际表现。
body.en: Evaluation reports wins and action use across seven difficulty tiers; successive levels test acquired rules, and tier difficulty depends on evaluated models.

body.zh: 公开集合含二十一个游戏，剩余部分用于私有评测；各划分分别报告结果。字符串状态、未知目标和可执行动作共同构成这套符号互动发现任务。
body.en: Twenty-one games are public and the remainder private, with split-specific reporting. String states, unknown goals and executable actions define the symbolic discovery setting.

body.zh: NCP-Bench 将互动叙事中的长期一致性定义为叙事承诺保持，提供一百个由电影梗概构成的环境，每个环境含轨迹、承诺和初始事实。
body.en: NCP-Bench defines narrative commitment preservation in one hundred movie-derived environments with trajectories, commitments and initial facts.

body.zh: 被测模型扮演叙述者，面对玩家代理的自由乃至对抗性干预持续生成故事；研究重点是语言流畅时仍能否保持既有事实和必要叙事条件。
body.en: The evaluated narrator responds to free-form or adversarial player interventions, testing whether fluent storytelling preserves facts and required narrative conditions.

body.zh: 结构化规范允许在互动中自动检查冲突，比较承诺存活率、事实冲突及成就承诺完成；随轮数变化的结果体现错误累积。
body.en: Structured specifications enable automatic checks of survival, fact conflicts and achievement commitments over turns, exposing accumulated consistency failures.

body.zh: 评测对象是维持叙事承诺的生成式叙述者，玩家代理通过多轮干预推动故事；事实一致、承诺存活和成就达成分别描述其长期叙事可靠性。
body.en: The evaluated role is a generative narrator preserving commitments while a player agent drives interventions; fact consistency, commitment survival and achievement completion describe reliability.

body.zh: RNG-Bench 包含翻牌配对和第一视角三维迷宫两种非马尔可夫游戏，正确行动依赖当前画面已不可见、但先前观察过的牌面或空间结构。
body.en: RNG-Bench uses Matching Pairs and egocentric 3D Maze, where actions depend on previously observed information absent from the current view.

body.zh: 翻牌要求保存牌与位置的对应，迷宫要求融合局部视角构建空间地图；统一框架控制网格规模、视觉图案与观察模态，以分析历史重建。
body.en: Matching Pairs requires card-location recall; Maze requires spatial integration. Grid size, patterns and observation modality control reconstruction difficulty.

body.zh: 配对比例、每对响应次数以及迷宫成功与效率反映行为表现；Memory Gap 配合对照条件区分遗忘和动作选择错误，并以对决协议降低实例差异。
body.en: Behavioral metrics cover matching, response cost, maze success and efficiency; Memory Gap separates forgetting from decision errors, while duels control instance variance.

body.zh: 两款游戏分别采用翻牌与第一视角导航动作，迷宫综合分结合成功、效率和探索。观察模态及历史负荷提供可控条件，Memory Gap 支持按错误来源分解。
body.en: The games use card flipping and egocentric navigation respectively; maze scores combine success, efficiency and exploration, while modalities, history load and Memory Gap support controlled error analysis.

body.zh: Rushes 记录用户在 AI 生成分支叙事中的选择，包含六个游戏、八千余名用户和四万余个决策事件，每条记录保留候选项、选择及演变语境。
body.en: Rushes records candidate sets, choices and evolving context from AI branching narratives: over forty thousand events from more than eight thousand users across six games.

body.zh: 数据以持续用户标识连接顺序轨迹，用于研究个体化参与偏好与多元对齐，关注同一用户在不同叙事阶段的选择差异。
body.en: Persistent user identifiers link sequential trajectories for research on personalized engagement preferences and pluralistic alignment.

body.zh: 基准以事件级选择预测比较语言模型、流行度基线和矩阵分解方法，分析选择熵及个性化信号；准确率反映对人类选择的拟合。
body.en: Event-level choice prediction compares LLMs, popularity baselines and matrix factorization, with choice entropy and personalized signal as additional analyses.

body.zh: 数据来自真实用户互动，发布基准采用离线事件选择预测，持续用户标识支持个体层面分析；候选集合和叙事历史共同界定每次预测的可用信息。
body.en: Real user interaction supplies offline choice-prediction data; persistent identifiers support individual-level analysis, with candidate sets and narrative history defining each prediction context.

body.zh: ChronoPlay 面向在线游戏领域的检索增强问答，自动追踪游戏内容更新及玩家社区关注点变化，把官方资料与社区提问模式共同纳入数据生成。
body.en: ChronoPlay generates game-domain RAG benchmarks by tracking content updates and changing community interests using official information and authentic query patterns.

body.zh: 其双动态机制研究知识新鲜度和真实玩家需求之间的关系，双来源合成在事实准确与提问自然性之间建立联系，并实例化于三个游戏。
body.en: Dual dynamics connects knowledge freshness with player demand; dual-source synthesis balances factual accuracy and authentic questions across three games.

body.zh: 评测单位是时间相关的问题、检索语境和回答，比较系统对版本变化及热点迁移的响应；知识来源时间是理解回答有效性的关键条件。
body.en: Evaluation concerns temporally situated questions, retrieval context and answers, assessing responses to version changes and shifts in community attention.

body.zh: 评测对象是游戏领域的动态检索与回答系统，三个游戏提供知识语境。官方信息时间、社区提问模式和回答证据共同限定每个版本的有效评价范围。
body.en: The target is dynamic game-domain retrieval and answering across three knowledge contexts, with official update times, community query patterns and answer evidence defining each benchmark version.

body.zh: FlashAdventure 提供三十四款 Flash 冒险游戏的屏幕交互评测，智能体通过点击、键盘和原生游戏界面完成指定里程碑、数值目标或故事任务。
body.en: FlashAdventure evaluates native screen interaction across thirty-four Flash adventures using clicks, keyboard inputs and game-specific milestones or numeric objectives.

body.zh: 研究重点是早期观察到的线索如何支持后续行动。COAST 以长期线索记忆组织计划，CUA-as-a-Judge 从实际游戏轨迹判定目标进展。
body.en: It studies how earlier clues inform later actions. COAST organizes planning around long-term clue memory, and CUA-as-a-Judge assesses gameplay progress.

body.zh: 离散任务报告里程碑完成比例，六种连续目标按人类参考归一化，并另列动作数；Game Cafe Escape 的依赖链体现道具、线索与逃离目标的先后关系。
body.en: Discrete tasks use milestone completion; six continuous objectives use human normalization. Action counts are separate, and Game Cafe Escape illustrates prerequisite chains.

body.zh: 各游戏按指定目标评价，两个 Grim Tales 场景聚焦初始找物，其余任务具有不同故事跨度；CUA-as-a-Judge 与完整代理配置共同参与结果生成。
body.en: Games are evaluated against their specified objectives; two Grim Tales scenes focus on initial hidden-object tasks, while story spans vary elsewhere and results depend on judge and agent configurations.

paragraphs.zh: 各游戏按指定目标评价，两个 Grim Tales 场景聚焦初始找物，其余任务具有不同故事跨度；CUA-as-a-Judge 与完整代理配置共同参与结果生成。
paragraphs.en: Games are evaluated against their specified objectives; two Grim Tales scenes focus on initial hidden-object tasks, while story spans vary elsewhere and results depend on judge and agent configurations.

body.zh: WhodunitBench 以剧本杀检验多模态智能体，玩家获得角色剧本、私有及公开文字与图像线索，通过讨论和最终投票识别凶手，凶手则隐藏身份。
body.en: WhodunitBench evaluates multimodal agents in murder mysteries using role scripts, private and public clues, discussion and voting to identify or conceal the murderer.

body.zh: 信息分配与角色目标构成动态推理场景，智能体需要整合视觉线索、他人陈述和动机证据；它同时提供互动竞技场和分解能力的问答链。
body.en: Role goals and asymmetric information require integration of visual clues, statements and motives. The suite includes an interactive arena and a separate question-based evaluation chain.

body.zh: 竞技场由五十个经过筛选的剧本构成，以角色对战胜率衡量结果；三千余道选择题与开放题用于分析感知和推理环节，作为独立的分解诊断报告。
body.en: The arena uses fifty curated scripts and role-conditioned win rates; more than three thousand separate questions analyze perception and reasoning.

body.zh: 互动竞技场和静态问答链分别形成整体表现与分解诊断，角色目标、线索分配和同场玩家策略构成竞技场条件；剧本级细节按对应设置解释。
body.en: The interactive arena and static question chain provide overall behavior and component diagnostics respectively; role goals, clue allocation and co-player policies define arena conditions.

body.zh: clembench 使用受约束的对话游戏评估聊天模型作为情境化交互者的表现，初始论文包含五种互动设置，通过程序化游戏管理器组织轮次与规则。
body.en: clembench evaluates chat models as situated conversational agents in five initial interaction settings managed through explicit rules and turns.

body.zh: 它将遵循互动格式与达到游戏目标分别记录，以分析模型能否形成连贯的协作行为。Taboo 中描述者知道目标和禁词，猜词者只能依据合法描述推断。
body.en: It separates interaction-format compliance from goal achievement. In Taboo, the describer sees the target and forbidden words while the guesser infers it from legal clues.

body.zh: 已核验的 Taboo 设定限制猜测次数并校验禁词；有效进行比例与成功所需轮数构成 clemscore，成功速度项采用 100/n。
body.en: The reviewed Taboo protocol limits guesses and checks taboo words; clemscore combines played ratio with a successful speed score of 100/n.

body.zh: Taboo 是框架中的一个双人协议，clemscore 描述模型配对的有效互动与目标达成。中止、合法失败和成功分开记录，其他游戏使用各自规则与目标。
body.en: Taboo is one two-player protocol; clemscore describes valid interaction and goal achievement of model pairs. Aborts, valid failures and successes are recorded separately across game-specific rules.

body.zh: Machiavelli 收集一百三十四款分支文字冒险游戏及大量社会决策场景，智能体从当前场景给出的选项中选择行动，争取预设成就。
body.en: Machiavelli collects 134 branching text adventures with social decision scenarios; agents select provided options to pursue specified achievements.

body.zh: 场景标注把权力寻求、不利后果和伦理违规转化为可计算的行为指标，研究奖励最大化与行为伤害之间的权衡，并比较降低伤害的引导方法。
body.en: Scenario annotations operationalize power-seeking, disutility and ethical violations to study reward-harm trade-offs and methods for steering behavior.

body.zh: 已审阅实验使用三十款测试游戏，报告归一化成就奖励，并把伤害相对一千条随机轨迹的均值归一化；语言模型基线输出选项编号。
body.en: The reviewed experiment uses thirty test games, normalized achievement reward and harm relative to one thousand random trajectories; language baselines output choice indices.

body.zh: 完整资源含一百三十四款游戏，审阅实验采用三十款测试子集。当前场景提示、目标成就和伤害标注定义主要评价信息，奖励与伦理指标分开报告。
body.en: The full resource contains 134 games, with thirty in the reviewed test subset. Current-scene prompts, achievements and harm annotations define evaluation, with reward and ethics reported separately.

body.zh: JerichoWorld 是面向文字冒险世界建模的监督数据集，将自然语言观察映射到描述世界状态的知识图谱，以及能够改变当前状态的有效文字动作。
body.en: JerichoWorld is a supervised text-adventure dataset mapping natural-language observations to world-state knowledge graphs and state-changing valid actions.

body.zh: 研究对象是部分可观测叙事中的结构化状态表示：房间、人物、物体及其关系需要从文本中恢复，规则、问答和序列学习模型提供基线。
body.en: It studies structured representations under partial observability, recovering locations, characters, objects and relations with rule-based, QA and sequence-learning baselines.

body.zh: 训练数据包含二十七款游戏的二万四千余条映射，另以九款游戏的七千余个保留实例测试，分别评价图谱恢复和有效动作预测。
body.en: Training comprises over twenty-four thousand mappings from twenty-seven games; more than seven thousand held-out examples from nine games test graph and action prediction.

body.zh: 资源以离线观察样本为评价单位，知识图谱与有效动作是监督目标；训练和保留测试按游戏划分，重点检验结构化文本世界模型对新游戏的预测泛化。
body.en: Offline observations are the evaluation units, with graphs and valid actions as supervised targets; game-level splits test predictive generalization of structured textual world models.

body.zh: TextWorld Commonsense 构造家庭物品整理文字环境，智能体阅读房间、库存与反馈，从候选命令中移动、拿取并把物品放到常识上合适的位置。
body.en: TextWorld Commonsense creates household tidying games where agents read room and inventory text and choose movement, pickup and placement commands.

body.zh: 任务检验物体属性与功能知识能否帮助行动筛选和前瞻推理；知识增强基线动态检索 ConceptNet，并把相关知识与顺序上下文结合。
body.en: The task tests whether object attributes and affordances improve action pruning and lookahead; knowledge-enhanced baselines dynamically retrieve ConceptNet information.

body.zh: 评测报告相对最大可得分的归一化分数与行动步数，使用域内和未见物品划分；审阅协议含五十步测试上限、多次训练运行与人类参照。
body.en: Evaluation reports normalized score and action count under in-distribution and unseen-object splits, with a fifty-step test limit, repeated runs and human references.

body.zh: 常识整理生成器限定物品、位置和功能关系，知识增强与基础代理分别对应不同信息条件。域内及未见物品划分提供对常识利用和迁移的具体比较。
body.en: The tidying generator specifies objects, locations and affordances; knowledge-enhanced and base agents have distinct information conditions, compared on seen and unseen objects.

body.zh: LongPuzzleBench 将六款视觉谜题的一百一十四关组织为十六个目标，智能体读取屏幕并使用原生坐标点击、拖动等操作，跨连续棋盘完成任务。
body.en: LongPuzzleBench groups 114 levels from six visual puzzles into sixteen objectives played through screenshots and native clicks, drags and other GUI actions.

body.zh: 持续棋盘中看似合法且有进展的动作可能破坏后续可解性，死局也不主动提示；研究重点是长行动链中保留未来选择及维持计划可行性。
body.en: Persistent boards can become unsolvable after apparently useful legal moves, without dead-end warnings, testing preservation of future options across long plans.

body.zh: 目标成功率、关卡完成率和细粒度进度分别衡量终局与中途表现，并按游戏宏平均；共享预算和主动重启机制共同约束完成过程。
body.en: Objective success, level completion and fine-grained progress are macro-averaged by game; shared budgets and agent-initiated restarts constrain completion.

body.zh: 原生 GUI 与代码执行条件分别体现视觉操作和可编程搜索，结果对应完整代理系统。持续棋盘、预算、重启和延迟共同构成十六个目标的完成条件。
body.en: Native GUI and code execution offer visual interaction and programmable search respectively. Complete-system results depend on persistent boards, budgets, restart and latency across sixteen objectives.

body.zh: WITNESS 提供二维网格隐藏规则谜题，智能体依据真实 ASCII 棋盘、尝试反馈和局内规则笔记，探索并提交满足约束的路径。
body.en: WITNESS provides 2D hidden-rule puzzles using ground-truth ASCII boards, interaction feedback and a rule notebook to discover valid paths.

body.zh: WitnessGym 生成训练任务，WitnessBench 将已学原语的新组合与训练外原语分开，配合直接提供规则的条件分析规则获取和规则执行两类瓶颈。
body.en: WitnessGym supports training; WitnessBench separates novel compositions from unseen rule primitives and uses revealed-rule conditions to distinguish acquisition from execution.

body.zh: 动作包括四向移动、提交和重置，每次调用最多十六步；完成关卡数与 RHAE-L5/L20 比较相对人类或最优参照的行动效率。
body.en: Actions include movement, submission and reset, with up to sixteen actions per call; solved levels and RHAE-L5/L20 capture completion and relative efficiency.

body.zh: 十七个私有测试游戏与八个公开验证游戏分别承担测试和开发角色；规则公开程度、观察接口及代理配置构成对照条件，笔记记录支持互动中的假设积累。
body.en: Seventeen private test games and eight public validation games serve separate roles; rule access, observation interface and agent configuration define controls, with notebooks tracking hypotheses.

body.zh: LVLM-Playground 将棋盘游戏组织为感知、问答、规则遵循和端到端游玩四条评测轨道，利用结构化游戏场景检验视觉语言模型的细粒度理解。
body.en: LVLM-Playground organizes board-game evaluation into perception, question answering, rule following and end-to-end play to probe detailed visual-language understanding.

body.zh: 分解轨道分析稠密棋盘元素、长结构化输出和规则推理的困难，端到端轨道则要求模型从棋盘截图与规则提示生成下一合法操作。
body.en: Diagnostic tracks analyze dense board elements, long structured outputs and rules; end-to-end play requires legal actions from board screenshots and instructions.

body.zh: 已核验的端到端任务覆盖六款游戏，包括井字棋、黑白棋和五子棋；附录定义游戏专属的进度、步数与终局奖励组合，并指定对手实现。

body.zh: Memory Gym 将 Mortar Mayhem、Mystery Path 和 Searing Spotlights 三种二维部分可观测环境扩展为无尽任务，让需要保存的信息随互动持续增长。
body.en: Memory Gym extends Mortar Mayhem, Mystery Path and Searing Spotlights into endless partially observable tasks with increasing memory demands.

body.zh: 它比较 GRU 和采用 Transformer-XL 滑动窗口的 PPO，研究有限任务中的样本效率与持续增长负荷下的记忆有效性是否给出一致结论。
body.en: The study compares GRU and Transformer-XL PPO, examining whether sample efficiency in finite tasks predicts memory effectiveness under growing endless loads.

body.zh: 目录代表单元 Endless Mortar Mayhem 逐次展示新指令，要求重演累积序列，以正确完成的序列长度衡量表现；观察为视觉输入并通过移动执行指令。
body.en: The representative Endless Mortar Mayhem task reveals additional commands and requires replay of the growing sequence, scoring correctly completed length from visual-input movement.

body.zh: 三种环境及有限、无尽版本具有各自的信息保存机制和负荷曲线。本文的循环网络与 Transformer-XL 比较采用强化学习策略，代表单元明确为无尽指令重演。
body.en: The environments and finite/endless variants have distinct memory mechanisms and load curves; the paper compares RL policies, with endless command replay as the representative unit.

body.zh: XLand-100B 是基于 XLand-MiniGrid 的大规模上下文强化学习数据集，收集近三万种任务的完整学习历史，包含一千亿条转移和二十五亿个回合。
body.en: XLand-100B provides complete learning histories for nearly thirty thousand XLand-MiniGrid tasks, totaling one hundred billion transitions and 2.5 billion episodes.

body.zh: 模型从过去观察、动作和奖励中学习适应未见规则与目标，测试时不更新权重；数据和生成工具旨在支持超出简单小规模环境的上下文学习研究。
body.en: Models adapt to unseen rules and goals from observation-action-reward histories without test-time weight updates; released data and tools support large-scale in-context RL.

body.zh: 互动使用五乘五局部符号观察及六种导航或物体交互动作，以随上下文长度变化的任务回报评价适应；离线历史供训练，在线新任务检验泛化。
body.en: Interaction uses local 5×5 symbolic views and six navigation or object actions; return versus context length measures adaptation after offline-history training.

body.zh: 资源包括离线训练历史和在线未见任务适应两部分，学习成功过滤定义收集分布。XLand-MiniGrid 采用局部符号状态，任务回报随上下文变化体现适应过程。
body.en: The resource combines offline histories with online adaptation to unseen tasks; success filtering defines the collection distribution, and symbolic MiniGrid returns trace contextual adaptation.

body.zh: ChildPlay 以 ASCII 编码的井字棋、四子棋、Battleship 和形状任务研究语言模型的非语言问题求解，并加入 LEGO 连接语言和分子结构相关任务。
body.en: ChildPlay studies nonlinguistic problem solving through ASCII board games and shape tasks, adding LEGO Connect Language and a molecular-structure task.

body.zh: 研究以简单明确的规则减少语言表达复杂性，比较不同 GPT 模型对空间结构、合法操作、获胜机会和阻挡需求的处理，观察能力提升是否跨任务一致。
body.en: Simple rules reduce linguistic complexity while comparing GPT models on spatial structures, legal moves, winning opportunities and blocking across tasks.

body.zh: 三种已审阅棋盘任务对随机对手行动，输出行列坐标或列编号，报告胜负平、非法动作及错失获胜或阻挡机会；其他任务使用各自结构判断。
body.en: Three reviewed board tasks use random opponents and coordinate or column actions, measuring outcomes, illegal moves and missed wins or blocks.

body.zh: 棋盘对战、形状识别、LEGO 结构与分子编码任务共同组成资源，分别使用相应评价方式。三种游玩任务采用 ASCII 表示、随机对手及论文特定规则。
body.en: The resource combines board play, shapes, LEGO structure and molecular encoding with task-specific evaluations; reviewed gameplay uses ASCII views, random opponents and paper-specific rules.

body.zh: GameTraversalBenchmark 让语言模型在二维网格地图上按顺序到达目标，每到一个目标后从新位置继续，既要求路径可执行，也要求减少步数和输出错误。
body.en: GameTraversalBenchmark asks LLMs to reach ordered targets on 2D maps, continuing from each reached position while minimizing route length and output errors.

body.zh: 输入包含文本地图、实体图例、当前位置及目标坐标，模型一次生成通向当前目标的动作序列；这一设计将空间表示与显式多步路径生成联系起来。
body.en: Text maps, legends, current positions and target coordinates support generation of an action sequence for each target, coupling spatial representation with multistep routing.

body.zh: 已审阅集合包含一百五十张 Word2World 地图，以 A* 路径为参照，报告 GTB-Score、不同错误容忍条件的准确率、路径长度及生成错误。
body.en: The reviewed set contains 150 Word2World maps with A* references, reporting GTB-Score, accuracy under error tolerances, route length and generation errors.

body.zh: 文本地图与一次生成的目标路径定义任务接口，综合分同时反映完成、路径成本和输出合法性。顺序目标、错误容忍和 A* 参照构成具体评价范围。
body.en: Text maps and per-target generated routes define the interface; composite scores reflect completion, route cost and valid output under sequential objectives, error tolerances and A* references.

body.zh: PUZZLES 把 Simon Tatham 的便携谜题集转为强化学习基准，涵盖四十种可调尺寸和复杂度的逻辑游戏，从桥梁连接、推演数字到网络与路径约束。
body.en: PUZZLES converts Simon Tatham’s collection into forty RL logic-puzzle environments with adjustable size and complexity, covering numeric, network and path constraints.

body.zh: 环境以内部离散棋盘状态为主要观察，并可提供 RGB 像素；游戏专属键盘动作把逻辑推断转化为逐步操作，用于比较算法推理和尺度泛化。
body.en: Discrete board states, optional RGB observations and puzzle-specific keyboard actions turn logical deductions into sequential operations for algorithmic reasoning research.

body.zh: 评测记录完成率和成功回合长度，并使用人类表现及最优步数上界作参照；已审阅材料覆盖四十种规则，尺寸泛化实验集中于其中三种。
body.en: Evaluation measures completion and successful episode length with human and optimal-step upper-bound references; reviewed rules cover forty puzzles, while size-generalization tests cover three.

body.zh: 四十种谜题共享环境框架，各自保持约束规则与操作方式；尺寸泛化结果对应三个测试游戏。棋盘编码、动作接口与解题策略共同影响完成和步数指标。
body.en: Forty puzzles share infrastructure while retaining specific constraints and controls; size-generalization results concern three tested games, with encoding, interface and strategy affecting completion and length.

body.zh: CARL 通过给经典控制、物理仿真和平台游戏加入可控上下文变量，构造可以明确指定训练及测试分布的强化学习环境库。
body.en: CARL adds controlled contextual variables to classic control, physics and platform environments, enabling explicitly defined training and test distributions.

body.zh: 它以情境化强化学习区分插值、分布偏移与外推，并比较隐藏上下文和显式上下文，研究环境变化时策略为何失效以及上下文信息如何帮助泛化。
body.en: Contextual RL separates interpolation, distribution shift and extrapolation, comparing hidden and visible context to study policy robustness under environmental variation.

body.zh: CARLMario 案例在程序生成的平台关卡中行动，视觉输入可额外提供生成噪声张量；以距起点的平均前进距离衡量关卡完成程度。
body.en: CARLMario traverses generated platform levels with visual observations and optionally the generation-noise tensor, evaluating mean distance progressed from the start.

body.zh: CARLMario 使用 TOAD-GAN 与 Mario AI Framework 的研究实现，关卡生成参数定义其上下文。其他控制与物理环境通过各自参数构造插值、偏移和外推分布。
body.en: CARLMario uses the TOAD-GAN and Mario AI Framework research implementation; level parameters define its context, while control and physics domains have their own distributions.

body.zh: GriddlyJS 是基于 Griddly 引擎的网页开发环境，用于设计、调试和发布程序生成的网格任务，并在浏览器中观察、评测与录制训练后策略。
body.en: GriddlyJS is a browser IDE for designing, debugging and publishing procedurally generated grid environments and inspecting trained policies.

body.zh: 资源将环境设计、模型可视化和可交互复现实验联系起来。EscapeRoom 案例中，智能体收集资源、制造工具并清除路线，最终到达樱桃树。
body.en: It connects environment design with interactive experiment reproduction. Its EscapeRoom case requires gathering resources, crafting tools and clearing a route to a cherry tree.

body.zh: 案例采用 GDY 定义的网格或图像观察和离散移动、采集、制作动作；PPO 检查点在一百个人工关卡与一百个随机关卡上比较解题率。
body.en: GDY-defined observations and discrete movement, harvesting and crafting actions support PPO solve-rate comparisons on one hundred human-designed and one hundred random levels.

body.zh: 完整资源是环境开发与发布平台，EscapeRoom 提供组合谜题的具体实验。人工设计和程序生成关卡组成两类测试分布，观察形式由 GDY 定义。
body.en: The full resource is an environment-development platform; EscapeRoom provides the concrete compositional-puzzle study with human-designed and generated distributions and GDY-defined observations.

paragraphs.zh: 完整资源是环境开发与发布平台，EscapeRoom 提供组合谜题的具体实验。人工设计和程序生成关卡组成两类测试分布，观察形式由 GDY 定义。
paragraphs.en: The full resource is an environment-development platform; EscapeRoom provides the concrete compositional-puzzle study with human-designed and generated distributions and GDY-defined observations.

body.zh: MESSENGER 要求智能体在十乘十符号网格中先取得信件，再送往正确目标并躲避敌人；自然语言手册描述实体身份及运动动力学。
body.en: MESSENGER asks agents to pick up a message, deliver it and avoid enemies on a 10×10 symbolic grid using a manual describing entities and dynamics.

body.zh: 实体符号与手册文本的联系并非预先给定，模型必须把角色及行为描述落地到游戏状态。EMMA 用实体条件注意力从相关手册句子学习潜在对应。
body.en: Agents learn the grounding between manual descriptions and entity symbols. EMMA uses entity-conditioned attention to connect relevant text with observed roles and behavior.

body.zh: 通过上、下、左、右和停留动作互动，取信、交付和失败分别提供反馈奖励；三阶段任务及未见实体动力学划分以胜率检验泛化。
body.en: Five movement or stay actions receive pickup, delivery and failure rewards; three stages and held-out entity-dynamics splits assess generalization through win rate.

body.zh: 测试划分围绕实体身份、运动方式和规则组合构造，手册可见性定义语言落地条件。胜率联合反映文本解释、动态理解和网格导航的执行效果。
body.en: Splits vary entity identities, dynamics and rule combinations under manual access; win rate jointly reflects language interpretation, dynamics understanding and grid navigation.

body.zh: SILG 用统一符号接口整合 RTFM、Messenger、NetHack、ALFWorld 与 Touchdown，覆盖规则手册、目标语言、局部世界与多步行动等落地问题。
body.en: SILG unifies RTFM, Messenger, NetHack, ALFWorld and Touchdown through symbolic interfaces spanning manuals, goals, partial observability and sequential action.

body.zh: 共享模型架构比较局部卷积、循环状态跟踪、实体注意力和预训练语言模型，研究在一个环境有效的设计能否跨观察、动作和语言分布保持收益。
body.en: A shared architecture tests local convolution, recurrent tracking, entity attention and pretrained language models for transfer of modeling gains across environments.

body.zh: 各环境以自己的任务成功条件评分；NetHack 使用 Score、Gold 与 Scout 阈值子任务，RTFM 与 Messenger 的已报告结果限于第一课程阶段。
body.en: Success criteria remain environment-specific: NetHack uses Score, Gold and Scout threshold tasks, while reviewed RTFM and Messenger results concern curriculum stage one.

body.zh: 五个环境共享符号接口并保留各自目标和成功标准。ALFWorld 与 Touchdown 使用视觉世界的符号对应，NetHack 以阈值子任务表达局部探索与得分目标。
body.en: Five domains share symbolic interfaces while retaining their own success criteria. ALFWorld and Touchdown use symbolic counterparts, and NetHack uses threshold-based exploration and scoring tasks.

body.zh: AutoWorldModel-Bench 把编码代理作为自主研究者，要求其在固定计算预算内修改基础世界模型，而不是直接控制玩家角色；套件包含八个自定义游戏环境。
body.en: AutoWorldModel-Bench evaluates coding agents autonomously improving a base world model under fixed compute across eight custom game environments.

body.zh: 环境以提取出的真实实体状态组成共享张量，隔离视觉感知与动态建模；代理运行实验、读取反馈并改变模型或训练方案，形成闭环研究过程。
body.en: Shared tensors of ground-truth entity state isolate dynamics from perception; agents iterate through experiments, feedback and changes to modeling or training.

body.zh: 最终采用保留测试划分衡量动态预测相对基础模型的改善，并分析有效修改是结构或训练改变还是简单超参数调整；固定预算约束搜索机会。
body.en: Held-out dynamics prediction measures improvement over the base model, with analysis of substantive model or training edits versus hyperparameter tuning under fixed budgets.

body.zh: 八款游戏采用项目自定义实现，统一实体状态格式用于动态预测；评价对象是代理修改后的研究代码与世界模型，保留测试数据检验模型改进的泛化。
body.en: Eight custom games supply uniform entity states for dynamics prediction; modified research code and world models are evaluated on held-out data for generalizable improvements.

body.zh: GBQA 构建三十款游戏和一百二十四个人工核验缺陷，覆盖三档难度，要求语言模型作为质量保证工程师主动发现运行中的错误。
body.en: GBQA contains thirty games and 124 human-verified bugs across three difficulty levels, evaluating LLM agents as autonomous QA engineers.

body.zh: 多智能体生成与缺陷注入过程结合专家检查建立题目，基线使用多轮 ReAct 和记忆机制探索游戏，通过动作与反馈逐步形成缺陷判断。
body.en: Multi-agent game construction and bug injection are checked by experts; a memory-equipped ReAct baseline explores games across turns to identify defects.

body.zh: 主要结果是对核验缺陷的发现率，评价不同模型在持续探索中的检测表现；游戏交互是获得错误证据的手段，而不是按常规胜利目标评分。
body.en: Evaluation measures detection of verified bugs across models; game interaction supplies evidence for defect reports and comparison against the validated bug set.

body.zh: 三十款游戏和人工核验缺陷集合定义质量保证范围，CASTLE 提供八房间文字冒险案例。代理记忆与探索策略用于取得错误证据，最终按缺陷发现结果评价。
body.en: Thirty games and verified defects define QA scope; CASTLE is an eight-room example. Memory and exploration gather evidence, while detected bugs determine performance.

body.zh: SPADE 是自博弈强化学习框架，同一个语言模型同时担任环境设计者和推理行动者；设计者编写带 reset/step 接口的完整可执行多轮环境。
body.en: SPADE is a self-play RL framework where one LLM acts as environment designer and reasoning agent, generating executable multi-turn reset/step environments.

body.zh: 环境包含状态转移、奖励与验证代码，以有无特权提示时的奖励差估计遗憾，推动设计者生成可行且位于当前学习能力边缘的任务。
body.en: State transitions, rewards and verification code define tasks; reward gaps with privileged hints estimate regret to target feasible challenges near the learner’s capability frontier.

body.zh: 文档材料为环境合成提供知识基础，累积环境记忆支持多样化；训练后的效果通过推理、编码和工具使用任务的迁移评价，而非固定游戏胜率。
body.en: Document grounding and accumulated environment memory diversify generation; downstream reasoning, coding and tool-use transfer evaluate the effects of training.

body.zh: 数学、逻辑、空间等类别定义环境合成范围，动态课程决定实际任务分布。环境设计者、受训推理代理和可执行验证代码分别承担生成、行动与奖励判定职责。
body.en: Cognitive categories define synthesis scope and adaptive curricula define task distributions; designer, reasoning learner and executable verifier perform generation, action and reward judgment.

body.zh: A2Z GameSpec-Bench 以一百份长篇游戏设计文档测试端到端游戏开发，编码代理需要把游戏逻辑、画面和玩家交互中的相互依赖要求实现为可运行作品。
body.en: A2Z GameSpec-Bench evaluates game development from one hundred long-form design documents with interdependent logic, rendering and interaction requirements.

body.zh: 每份文档转成包含规则、约束和前置关系的依赖合同；同一合同在不同代理与修改轮次中固定，使遗漏需求与破坏依赖可以对应到具体证据。
body.en: Dependency-aware contracts encode rules, constraints and prerequisites, remaining fixed across agents and revisions so failures can be linked to specific requirements.

body.zh: 评价结合源代码检查、代理生成的测试策略、场景重放和自适应游玩测试，以 GDD Fidelity 衡量实现忠实度，并比较反馈驱动修改与自我修改。
body.en: Evaluation combines source inspection, generated test policies, replay and adaptive playtesting, measuring GDD Fidelity and comparing requirement feedback with self-revision.

body.zh: 评价对象是从长篇设计到可运行游戏的开发忠实度。游玩测试提供运行证据，源代码检查提供实现证据，依赖合同把两者对应到同一组固定需求。
body.en: The target is development fidelity from long designs to runnable games; playtesting and source inspection provide complementary evidence linked to fixed requirements by dependency contracts.

sources.title: A2Z GameSpec-Bench: How Faithfully Can Coding Agents Generate Games from Game Design Specifications?

body.zh: CraftBench-UE 提供七十项 Unreal Engine 开发任务，覆盖 C++、Blueprint 资产和编辑器脚本，代理在隔离工程中实现指定玩法功能。
body.en: CraftBench-UE provides seventy Unreal Engine development tasks across C++, Blueprint assets and editor scripting in isolated projects.

body.zh: 评测框架把已保存提交重建到新工程，分别检查构建、资产和运行行为，避免将能编译或存在指定节点等价为玩法正确；裁决由确定性测试产生。
body.en: Saved submissions are reconstructed in fresh projects for deterministic build, asset and runtime checks, separating structural validity from correct gameplay behavior.

body.zh: 实验比较七种模型与两类编辑器工具配置，并设置相同玩法和运行测试的 C++/Blueprint 配对任务，以完成率和运行断言揭示交付形式差异。
body.en: Experiments compare seven models and two editor-tool configurations, including paired C++ and Blueprint tasks sharing gameplay specifications and runtime tests.

body.zh: 任务按引擎功能、资产形式与工具配置组织，保存的提交在新工程中接受统一裁决。构建、资产和运行检查分别反映交付链条中的不同完成层次。
body.en: Tasks vary engine features, asset forms and tools; saved submissions receive uniform fresh-project evaluation, with build, asset and runtime checks representing distinct completion stages.

body.zh: GameASG-Bench 包含四十七项浏览器原生游戏生成任务，覆盖十二类主要类型与二维、三维互动，编码代理依据需求生成可运行且可测试的应用。
body.en: GameASG-Bench comprises forty-seven browser-native game-generation tasks across twelve primary genres and both 2D and 3D interaction.

body.zh: 生成前公开评测接口规范，固定合法起始场景、玩家级动作、稳定快照、拒绝行为及不变量，同时允许代理自由选择内部实现。
body.en: An evaluation interface fixes legal starting scenarios, player actions, snapshots, rejection behavior and invariants before generation while leaving implementation choices open.

body.zh: L1 检查源代码层合规，L2 在真实浏览器输入与语义观察中验证运行行为；严格任务成功要求全部适用的前置和核心检查通过。
body.en: L1 checks source compliance and L2 checks browser-executed behavior using real inputs and semantic observations; strict success requires all applicable prerequisite and core checks.

body.zh: 四十七项任务各有参考实现和可执行检查，严格成功与平均检查通过率分别报告。类型覆盖描述开发需求分布，统一接口则保障不同实现的行为可比性。
body.en: Each of forty-seven tasks has a reference and executable checks; strict success and mean check pass rate are reported separately, with common interfaces enabling behavioral comparison.

paragraphs.zh: GameASG-Bench 包含四十七项浏览器原生游戏生成任务，覆盖十二类主要类型与二维、三维互动，编码代理依据需求生成可运行且可测试的应用。
paragraphs.en: GameASG-Bench comprises forty-seven browser-native game-generation tasks across twelve primary genres and both 2D and 3D interaction.

paragraphs.zh: 生成前公开评测接口规范，固定合法起始场景、玩家级动作、稳定快照、拒绝行为及不变量，同时允许代理自由选择内部实现。
paragraphs.en: An evaluation interface fixes legal starting scenarios, player actions, snapshots, rejection behavior and invariants before generation while leaving implementation choices open.

paragraphs.zh: L1 检查源代码层合规，L2 在真实浏览器输入与语义观察中验证运行行为；严格任务成功要求全部适用的前置和核心检查通过。
paragraphs.en: L1 checks source compliance and L2 checks browser-executed behavior using real inputs and semantic observations; strict success requires all applicable prerequisite and core checks.

paragraphs.zh: 四十七项任务各有参考实现和可执行检查，严格成功与平均检查通过率分别报告。类型覆盖描述开发需求分布，统一接口则保障不同实现的行为可比性。
paragraphs.en: Each of forty-seven tasks has a reference and executable checks; strict success and mean check pass rate are reported separately, with common interfaces enabling behavioral comparison.

sources.title: GameASG-Bench: Benchmarking Autonomous Software Generation for Game Development

body.zh: GameLogicBench 提供七十二项 Godot 游戏逻辑实现与修复任务，从孤立机制、系统交互延伸到仓库级功能，代理修改工程以满足指定行为。
body.en: GameLogicBench provides seventy-two Godot logic implementation and repair tasks spanning isolated mechanics, interacting systems and repository-scale features.

body.zh: 评测器在每个模拟 tick 检查规则，而非仅观察合法终局；四百余个人工场景经种子参数扩展成一千四百余测试，覆盖运行中的暂时违规。
body.en: The evaluator checks rules at every simulation tick; over four hundred scenarios yield more than fourteen hundred seeded tests capable of exposing transient violations.

body.zh: 确定性裁决同时接受不同正确实现，并用移除必要功能的变异程序验证拒错能力；任务解决率用于比较模型与支架组合以及任务规模带来的变化。
body.en: Deterministic judgments accept diverse correct implementations and reject capability-removal mutants; task solve rates compare model-scaffold combinations and task scales.

body.zh: 评价对象是 Godot 工程的游戏逻辑，角色动作由提交程序执行。任务规模、逐帧断言、变异验证与外部代码访问条件共同组成模型和支架比较的背景。
body.en: The target is Godot gameplay logic executed by submitted programs; task scale, tick assertions, mutant validation and external-code access define model-scaffold comparisons.

body.zh: GameXpert-Bench 将游戏开发生命周期拆成 GameGen、GameFix 和 GameOpt 三条轨道，分别测试从零生成、缺陷诊断修复和多轮累积优化。
body.en: GameXpert-Bench separates game development into GameGen creation, GameFix diagnosis and repair, and GameOpt cumulative multiround optimization.

body.zh: 生成轨道从空工作区接收完整需求，修复轨道区分已报告和待发现问题，优化轨道由真实人机开发轨迹形成请求链，强调修改后的功能保持。
body.en: Creation starts from an empty workspace, repair distinguishes reported from undiscovered defects, and optimization uses trajectory-derived request chains with functionality preservation.

body.zh: 套件含九十七个生成任务、一百个修复任务和十七条六轮优化链，结合实时游玩、确定性行为测试、产品指标与回归检查评价不同阶段。
body.en: The suite has ninety-seven creation tasks, one hundred repair tasks and seventeen six-turn optimization chains, using playtesting, behavioral tests, product criteria and regression checks.

body.zh: 三条轨道分别报告生成、修复和迭代优化结果，产品质量与回归保持形成互补证据。当前公开发布提供支架，完整任务文件的发布状态在来源中单独记录。
body.en: Creation, repair and optimization are reported separately, combining product quality with regression preservation. The public scaffold and full task-file release status are recorded separately.

body.zh: PlayTrain 将语言模型生成的 JavaScript 游戏接入高效强化学习流水线，同一文件既可供人类浏览器游玩，也可用于像素策略训练和规则修改实验。
body.en: PlayTrain connects LLM-generated JavaScript games to efficient RL, allowing the same file to support human browser play, pixel-policy training and rule modifications.

body.zh: 框架以单文件游戏减少环境开发成本，并展示 Atari、Procgen 风格副本与新动力学变体；IMPALA-CNN 等视觉编码支持端到端学习。
body.en: Single-file games reduce environment-development cost, with Atari- and Procgen-style clones and altered dynamics supporting end-to-end visual-policy learning.

body.zh: 已审阅八款游戏报告平均单局分数与达到人类均值所需训练步数，训练逐回合采样种子，最终检查点在八个保留种子上测试；吞吐另作系统指标。
body.en: Eight reviewed games report mean scores and steps to human means, sampling training seeds by episode and testing final checkpoints on eight held-out seeds; throughput is separate.

body.zh: 游戏副本和规则变体采用项目生成的 JavaScript 实现。保留种子、训练重复与人类参与者分别对应测试分布、算法方差和人类参照，按不同统计层级报告。
body.en: Clones and variants use generated JavaScript implementations; held-out seeds, training repetitions and human participants represent test distributions, algorithm variance and human references respectively.

body.zh: PROWBench 评估视频模型是否把程序指定的世界事件正确渲染，包含一百七十段可重放程序场景与六百段代理视频，记录实体状态及带时间戳事件。
body.en: PROWBench tests whether video models render program-specified events using 170 replayable episodes and 600 proxy videos with entity states and timestamped events.

body.zh: 可执行世界记录将动力学与视觉生成分离，连摄像机视野外事件也被保存；同步视角和粗三维或边界框代理表示连接程序状态与可见后果。
body.en: Executable records separate dynamics from visual generation, including off-camera events; synchronized views and proxy representations link state to visible consequences.

body.zh: Logic-Render Alignment 与 Interaction Success Rate 两类 VLM 指标检查时间线一致和交互实现，并通过实体控制、长程事件及多视角场景分析渲染可靠性。
body.en: VLM-based Logic-Render Alignment and Interaction Success Rate assess timeline adherence and event realization across entity-control, long-horizon and multiview settings.

body.zh: 当前论文以 PROWBench 命名，ROWBench 保留为关联名称。评价对象是视频对程序事件的视觉遵循性，VLM 负责指标判定，实体轨迹与事件记录提供参考真值。
body.en: The current paper uses PROWBench, with ROWBench retained as an associated name. Video adherence is evaluated by VLM metrics against entity trajectories and event records.

body.zh: GVGAI-LLM 把街机式游戏以紧凑 ASCII 地图、规则、目标和动作映射呈现给语言模型，智能体逐步选择引擎允许的离散动作完成各游戏任务。
body.en: GVGAI-LLM presents arcade games as ASCII maps with rules, goals and action mappings; LLM agents select legal engine actions step by step.

body.zh: 基于游戏描述语言的规则与关卡生成使测试内容可扩展，研究空间表征、基本规划与行动有效性；推箱子的不可逆死锁提供具体规划诊断。
body.en: A game-description language supports extensible rules and levels, probing spatial representation, planning and action utility; box-pushing deadlocks provide a concrete diagnostic.

body.zh: 指标包括胜率、归一化奖励、有意义步比例、步效率和综合分；一百一十八款初步遍历与六款跨模型比较子集使用不同覆盖范围。
body.en: Metrics include wins, normalized reward, meaningful steps, efficiency and composite score; the 118-game preliminary sweep differs from the six-game cross-model subset.

body.zh: 默认接口提供当前 ASCII 状态与规则，六款跨模型子集和全套初步遍历分别报告。两种推箱实现提供明确空间规划案例，整体指标反映多种行为因素。
body.en: The default interface provides current ASCII state and rules; six-game cross-model results and the full preliminary sweep are distinct, with two box-pushing implementations providing planning cases.

body.zh: RPGBench 让语言模型担任文字角色扮演游戏引擎，包含世界创建与游戏模拟两项任务：生成可玩世界，并在多轮互动中按规则更新事件和状态。
body.en: RPGBench evaluates LLMs as text-RPG engines through world creation and multiround simulation with rule-consistent event and state updates.

body.zh: 结构化事件状态表示把叙事内容与机制约束连接，要求世界具有有效终止条件，并在自由文本交互中保持变量变化、事件触发和逻辑一致。
body.en: Structured event-state representations connect narrative content to mechanics, requiring valid termination conditions, variable updates and consistent event triggers.

body.zh: 客观指标自动检查事件机制和变量更新，主观内容趣味、动作质量及角色扮演由语言模型评判；两类证据共同描述创意与规则可靠性。
body.en: Automatic checks evaluate event mechanics and state updates, while an LLM judge assesses interestingness, action quality and role-playing.

body.zh: 评测对象是世界生成和模拟引擎，玩家输入驱动多轮情境；自动机制检查与模型主观评分分别报告，共同描述状态一致性、规则执行和叙事内容质量。
body.en: The evaluated role is the world-generation and simulation engine; player input drives multiround scenarios, while automatic mechanics checks and subjective model judgments are reported separately.

body.zh: VideoGameQA-Bench 面向视觉语言模型的游戏质量保证，提供游戏图像与视频中的视觉单元测试、回归测试、异常检索、故障识别及缺陷报告生成。
body.en: VideoGameQA-Bench evaluates VLMs on game-image and video QA, including visual unit and regression tests, anomaly search, glitch detection and bug reports.

body.zh: 它将传统依赖人工审阅的视觉检查转为标准化模型任务，关注细小异常、跨画面差异和长视频中的关键证据，覆盖不同质量保证活动。
body.en: It standardizes visual checks traditionally requiring manual review, probing subtle anomalies, frame differences and critical evidence in longer videos.

body.zh: 模型根据提供的图像或视频回答测试问题或生成报告，按各子任务的参考答案和质量标准评价；不同媒体与任务形式共同决定需要检索的证据。
body.en: Models answer questions or produce reports from supplied images and videos, evaluated against task-specific references and quality criteria.

body.zh: 图像与视频构成离线输入，问题回答和缺陷报告构成输出。各子任务分别评价视觉检查、异常定位或报告生成，游戏覆盖标识数据来源与质量保证情境。
body.en: Images and videos are offline inputs, with answers and reports as outputs. Task-specific evaluation covers inspection, anomaly localization and reporting within the represented game contexts.

paragraphs.en: Images and videos are offline inputs, with answers and reports as outputs. Task-specific evaluation covers inspection, anomaly localization and reporting within the represented game contexts.

body.zh: Gymnasium 为强化学习环境提供标准 API、环境集合及自定义工具，用统一的重置、行动、奖励与结束反馈接口连接算法和不同模拟任务。
body.en: Gymnasium provides a standard RL API, environment collection and customization tools linking algorithms to reset, action, reward and termination interfaces.

body.zh: 资源重点是环境与学习算法的互操作性、可复用性和可重复实验，区分自然终止与时间截断等接口语义，使训练过程能正确处理回合边界。
body.en: It emphasizes interoperability and reproducibility, including interface semantics that distinguish termination from truncation for correct episode-boundary handling.

body.zh: 具体示例 CartPole-v1 使用车体位置速度、杆角度角速度四维观察，输出左右推力，按保持平衡的累计步奖励评价，同时受越界与杆倾角终止限制。
body.en: The CartPole-v1 example uses four state variables and left/right force actions, measuring accumulated balancing reward subject to cart-position and pole-angle termination.

body.zh: CartPole-v1 是当前官方任务定义中的具体控制例，平台另提供多类环境与封装工具。版本、算法预算、随机种子和封装选项共同确定实验设置。
body.en: CartPole-v1 is one current official control task within a broader environment and wrapper library; versions, algorithm budgets, seeds and wrappers determine each experiment.

body.zh: BenchMARL 以 TorchRL 为后端，把多智能体算法、模型和环境配置组织成统一训练与报告框架，使不同实验组合可以在明确设置下系统比较。
body.en: BenchMARL uses TorchRL to standardize configurations, training and reporting across multi-agent algorithms, models and environments.

body.zh: 研究动机是多智能体强化学习的复现与公平比较，配置化接口减少实现差异，平台同时支持高效维护的算法组件及跨场景汇总分析。
body.en: It addresses MARL reproducibility and fair comparison by reducing implementation differences through configurable, maintained algorithm components and systematic reporting.

body.zh: 已核验 VMAS Navigation 案例要求智能体接近各自目标并避免碰撞，基于位置速度、相对目标和激光距离控制平面运动，以进展、完成与碰撞构成回报。
body.en: The reviewed VMAS Navigation task uses motion and lidar observations to reach individual goals while avoiding collisions, with progress, completion and collision rewards.

body.zh: VMAS Navigation 以具体配置定义动作形式和非共享奖励，论文实验与当前配置分别标识。任务回报描述导航表现，套件聚合统计描述跨环境的算法稳定性。
body.en: VMAS Navigation configurations specify action type and nonshared rewards; historical and current settings are distinguished, with task return and suite statistics serving separate roles.

body.zh: JaxMARL 提供在 JAX 中实现的多智能体环境和基线算法，把环境模拟与训练放到加速器上并行执行，覆盖多种合作、竞争和部分可观测任务。
body.en: JaxMARL implements multi-agent environments and baselines in JAX, enabling accelerator-parallel simulation and training across cooperative and competitive tasks.

body.zh: 其 SMAX 是不依赖 StarCraft II 引擎的简化向量化微操环境，分散策略根据局部友敌信息选择单位动作，支持高效研究协同战斗与自博弈。
body.en: SMAX is vectorized simplified micromanagement without the StarCraft II engine, using local observations and decentralized unit actions for efficient coordinated-combat research.

body.zh: SMAX 以视野内生命、位置、冷却及类型等观察驱动移动、停止和目标攻击，报告胜率及伤害与获胜组成的回报；吞吐和训练速度另作系统指标。
body.en: SMAX agents move, stop or attack from local health, position and cooldown observations; win rate and combat return are separate from system-throughput metrics.

body.zh: SMAX 使用独立向量化战斗模拟和自己的奖励尺度，集中于单位微操。其他 JaxMARL 环境保留各自规则，加速比和环境验证作为系统层面结果报告。
body.en: SMAX uses independent vectorized combat simulation and its own rewards for micromanagement; other domains retain their rules, and speedups and environment validation are system-level results.

body.zh: 该资源为离线多智能体强化学习提出标准基线与评价协议，智能体利用固定数据学习协作策略，再在对应模拟环境中检验，而非训练时持续采集新轨迹。
body.en: This resource standardizes offline MARL baselines and evaluation: policies learn from fixed datasets and are subsequently tested in corresponding simulators.

body.zh: 研究通过重审既有工作揭示基线实现、检查点选择与统计报告的不一致，并展示简单可靠的实现也能匹配复杂方法，重点是可比较的实证进展。
body.en: It identifies inconsistencies in implementations, checkpoint selection and reporting, showing that reliable simple baselines can match sophisticated methods.

body.zh: 已审阅协议按 MPE、SMACv1 与 MAMuJoCo 固定不同更新预算，使用十个种子、每次三十二回合评价；SMAC 以分数据质量的场景胜率报告团队微操。
body.en: Reviewed budgets differ across MPE, SMACv1 and MAMuJoCo; evaluation uses ten seeds and thirty-two episodes, with SMAC wins separated by dataset quality.

body.zh: 数据质量、固定更新预算和检查点选择交互共同定义离线协议。SMAC 单元对应固定轨迹学习后的单位战斗，跨场景与跨种子统计用于比较策略稳定性。
body.en: Dataset quality, fixed update budgets and checkpoint-selection interaction define the offline protocol; SMAC evaluates learned micromanagement with scenario and seed statistics.

body.zh: TextWorldExpress 以高性能模拟器重实现 CookingWorld、TextWorld Commonsense 和 Coin Collector 三类文字游戏，用文字房间、物品和动作反馈支持交互。
body.en: TextWorldExpress efficiently reimplements CookingWorld, TextWorld Commonsense and Coin Collector using textual rooms, objects and action feedback.

body.zh: 核心贡献是降低旧工具链的模拟成本，使大规模语言代理训练可行；做饭要求按食谱处理原料，整理要求归置物品，找币则强调房间探索。
body.en: Its core contribution reduces simulation cost for large-scale language-agent training; cooking, household tidying and coin retrieval retain distinct task structures.

body.zh: 代理提交文字命令，接口可返回有效动作列表；任务表现按归一化分数和完成情况评价，模拟每秒步数与代理策略得分分开报告。
body.en: Agents issue text commands with optional valid-action lists; normalized score and completion measure task performance, separately from simulator steps per second.

body.zh: 论文版本包含三类重实现游戏，后续库新增内容按版本区分。各生成器保留自己的地图与任务分布，模拟吞吐、任务分数和策略完成情况分别报告。
body.en: The paper version contains three reimplemented families, distinguished from later additions; generator distributions, simulation throughput, scores and completion are reported separately.

body.zh: U3 以 Unity 实现可配置的三维强化学习环境工具包，包含 OpenXLand 对 XLand 2.0 风格地形、物体和任务规则的实现，可程序化生成多样世界。
body.en: U3 is a configurable Unity toolkit with OpenXLand implementations of XLand-2.0-style terrains, objects and rules for diverse procedural 3D worlds.

body.zh: 用户可以修改地形与生产规则，智能体从第一人称图像和互动中发现物体转化及目标条件；资源同时提供精选规则地形与强化学习基线。
body.en: Configurable terrains and production rules let agents discover object transformations and goals from first-person interaction, supported by curated configurations and RL baselines.

body.zh: 具体互动通过移动和物体操作触发规则，以任务或任务集合的回合回报评价；满足目标的每步获得奖励，试验时长和行动预算由配置指定。
body.en: Movement and object interactions trigger rules; episode returns evaluate tasks or task collections, with per-step goal rewards and configured trial lengths.

body.zh: OpenXLand 的任务规则、地形和试验预算由配置明确给定，基础回报联合反映探索和执行。生成数据规模、任务集合表现与单任务回报分别描述资源的不同层次。
body.en: Configured rules, terrains and budgets define OpenXLand tasks; return reflects exploration and execution, while data scale, collection performance and individual returns describe distinct resource levels.

body.zh: MARLlib 通过标准多智能体环境封装、智能体级算法实现和灵活策略映射，把多样任务与训练方案解耦，提供可扩展的强化学习开发库。
body.en: MARLlib combines standardized environment wrappers, agent-level algorithms and flexible policy mapping to decouple multi-agent tasks from training strategies.

body.zh: 框架依据任务属性组织训练配置，减少算法与环境组合的兼容成本，使研究者能比较不同参数共享、价值学习和策略组织方式。
body.en: Task-aware configuration reduces compatibility cost and supports comparisons across parameter sharing, value learning and policy organization.

body.zh: Simple Spread 示例让三名智能体覆盖三个地标并避免碰撞，观察自身状态和相对位置，以四向移动或不动行动；回报含地标距离与碰撞罚分。
body.en: The Simple Spread example uses three agents covering three landmarks while avoiding collisions, with relative-state observations, movement actions and distance/collision penalties.

body.zh: Simple Spread 提供明确的地标覆盖示例，平台还支持多种环境与策略映射。离散或连续动作、新版参数和历史实现分别标识，以对应各自的奖励与训练条件。
body.en: Simple Spread supplies a landmark-coverage example within a broader library; action variants, newer parameters and historical implementations are distinguished by reward and training conditions.

body.zh: CORA 将基准、基线和指标整合为持续强化学习平台，包含 Atari、Procgen、NetHack 系列及家居模拟 CHORES，使智能体顺序学习变化中的任务。
body.en: CORA integrates benchmarks, baselines and metrics for continual RL across Atari, Procgen, NetHack and home-simulation CHORES task sequences.

body.zh: 研究重点是在学习新任务的同时保持旧技能，区分灾难性遗忘、可塑性、泛化和样本效率；训练序列及任务切换决定迁移问题的结构。
body.en: It studies retention alongside new learning, separating forgetting, plasticity, generalization and sample efficiency under explicit task sequences and switches.

body.zh: Continual Evaluation、Isolated Forgetting 和 Zero-Shot Forward Transfer 描述学习全过程；已核验的 Procgen 与 MiniHack 单元使用各自视觉或符号观察和离散动作。
body.en: Continual Evaluation, Isolated Forgetting and Zero-Shot Forward Transfer describe learning trajectories; reviewed Procgen and MiniHack units retain their own observations and actions.

body.zh: Procgen 单元对应顺序训练的六款游戏，MiniHack 对应审阅的持续学习序列。遗忘与迁移指标描述跨训练任务的变化，Atari 与 CHORES 保留各自任务序列范围。
body.en: The Procgen unit covers six sequentially trained games and MiniHack the reviewed continual sequence; forgetting and transfer track cross-task learning, with separate Atari and CHORES scopes.

paragraphs.zh: CORA 将基准、基线和指标整合为持续强化学习平台，包含 Atari、Procgen、NetHack 系列及家居模拟 CHORES，使智能体顺序学习变化中的任务。
paragraphs.en: CORA integrates benchmarks, baselines and metrics for continual RL across Atari, Procgen, NetHack and home-simulation CHORES task sequences.

paragraphs.zh: 研究重点是在学习新任务的同时保持旧技能，区分灾难性遗忘、可塑性、泛化和样本效率；训练序列及任务切换决定迁移问题的结构。
paragraphs.en: It studies retention alongside new learning, separating forgetting, plasticity, generalization and sample efficiency under explicit task sequences and switches.

paragraphs.zh: Continual Evaluation、Isolated Forgetting 和 Zero-Shot Forward Transfer 描述学习全过程；已核验的 Procgen 与 MiniHack 单元使用各自视觉或符号观察和离散动作。
paragraphs.en: Continual Evaluation, Isolated Forgetting and Zero-Shot Forward Transfer describe learning trajectories; reviewed Procgen and MiniHack units retain their own observations and actions.

paragraphs.zh: Procgen 单元对应顺序训练的六款游戏，MiniHack 对应审阅的持续学习序列。遗忘与迁移指标描述跨训练任务的变化，Atari 与 CHORES 保留各自任务序列范围。
paragraphs.en: The Procgen unit covers six sequentially trained games and MiniHack the reviewed continual sequence; forgetting and transfer track cross-task learning, with separate Atari and CHORES scopes.

body.zh: EnvPool 是高并行强化学习环境执行引擎，以高效调度减少模拟成为训练瓶颈的开销，并与多种强化学习库连接，支持从笔记本到大型机器的执行。
body.en: EnvPool is a highly parallel RL environment engine that reduces simulation bottlenecks and integrates with training libraries across laptops and larger systems.

body.zh: 资源同时研究系统吞吐与实际策略学习耗时；Atari 和物理控制环境的并行模拟展示运行效率，学习示例检验速度能否转化为更快获得有效策略。
body.en: It studies simulation throughput and policy-learning time, distinguishing fast environment execution from faster acquisition of effective behavior.

body.zh: Pong 学习案例用 PPO 控制右侧球拍，观察默认四帧八十四乘八十四灰度图并选择最小离散动作，以回报随墙钟时间变化评价学习，FPS 单列。
body.en: The PPO Pong example uses stacked grayscale frames and minimal discrete actions to control the paddle, reporting return over wall-clock time separately from FPS.

body.zh: Pong 是论文中的策略学习案例，环境并行数与调参构成比较条件。历史实验与当前文档默认配置分别标识，回报、墙钟训练时间和模拟吞吐分别表达能力与效率。
body.en: Pong is a policy-learning case with parallelism and tuning as comparison conditions; historical and current settings are distinguished, and return, wall-clock time and throughput serve separate roles.

body.zh: 该研究分析合作 MARL 文献的评价实践，并提出标准化性能评价流程，涵盖数据采集、汇总与结果报告。
body.en: The study examines evaluation practice in cooperative MARL and proposes standardized collection, aggregation and reporting procedures.

body.zh: 用于研究合作式多智能体强化学习结果的统计可靠性、可复现性与跨论文可比性。元分析把实验预算、种子和汇总方式作为研究对象。
body.en: It studies reliability, reproducibility and comparability of cooperative MARL results through meta-analysis of budgets, seeds and aggregation.

body.zh: 以多次运行的表现、统计汇总和不确定性描述方法差异，结合公开的元分析数据审查实验结论。
body.en: Repeated-run performance, statistical summaries and uncertainty characterize method differences, supported by public meta-analysis data.

body.zh: 资源性质为实验评价协议与分析工具，输入为既有任务上的训练和测试结果；游戏任务由原实验环境提供。
body.en: This is an evaluation protocol and analysis resource using training/test results from existing tasks.

body.zh: EPyMARL 扩展 PyMARL 的合作式算法与环境接口，支持等级觅食、仓库配送及其他多智能体任务。智能体通过协同行动获取团队奖励。
body.en: EPyMARL extends cooperative algorithms and environment interfaces to foraging, warehouse delivery and other multi-agent tasks.

body.zh: 用于系统比较合作 MARL 算法在不同任务结构中的学习效率与团队回报，研究算法实现和任务设置对结果的影响。
body.en: It compares cooperative MARL algorithms across task structures, studying learning efficiency, team return and implementation effects.

body.zh: 报告平均回合回报和学习曲线，并通过重复训练与多回合测试比较表现。不同环境的回报按各自任务定义解释。
body.en: Mean episode returns and learning curves are evaluated across training repetitions and test episodes using environment-specific reward definitions.

body.zh: 评测按环境和任务配置组织，涵盖等级觅食、仓库配送等任务；在策略与离策略方法采用相应训练预算。
body.en: Evaluation is organized by environment and task configuration, including foraging and warehouse delivery with algorithm-appropriate training budgets.

body.zh: PettingZoo 为多智能体环境提供 Agent Environment Cycle 和并行接口，覆盖棋类、街机及合作控制等不同交互形式。
body.en: PettingZoo supplies Agent Environment Cycle and parallel APIs for board, arcade and cooperative-control environments.

body.zh: 用于多智能体强化学习的环境复用、算法开发及顺序行动与并行行动建模。统一接口便于在不同游戏中组织交互实验。
body.en: It supports reusable MARL environments, algorithm development and modeling of sequential and parallel interaction.

body.zh: 各环境采用自身的收益、成功条件或胜负指标。例如 Pistonball 通过球的推进与时间成本计分，评价多个活塞的协作。
body.en: Metrics follow each environment’s payoff, success or win conditions; Pistonball scores ball progress and time costs.

body.zh: PettingZoo 是环境接口与任务集合，具体评测由所选游戏、规则、观测和回报定义。Pistonball 是其中的协作控制示例。
body.en: PettingZoo is an API and environment collection. Selected games define rules, observations and rewards; Pistonball is one cooperative-control example.

body.zh: rliable 提供强化学习实验的统计分析方法与实现，从既有得分中估计聚合表现和置信区间。
body.en: rliable provides statistical methods and software for aggregate performance and confidence intervals from existing RL scores.

body.zh: 用于研究少量随机种子条件下的强化学习算法比较，描述跨任务表现与统计不确定性。
body.en: It supports RL comparisons with limited random seeds, characterizing cross-task performance and statistical uncertainty.

body.zh: 采用四分位均值、性能分布、提升概率和分层 bootstrap 区间，分析算法之间的表现差异。
body.en: Interquartile means, performance profiles, probability of improvement and stratified bootstrap intervals characterize algorithm differences.

body.zh: 输入为多个任务及多次训练的得分矩阵，适用于 Atari、Procgen 等实验结果的统计分析。
body.en: Inputs are score matrices across tasks and training runs, including results from Atari and Procgen.

body.zh: URLB 将无奖励交互预训练与指定控制任务上的适应结合，智能体先收集通用经验，再学习站立、行走或操作等目标。
body.en: URLB combines reward-free interaction with adaptation to specified control goals such as standing, locomotion and manipulation.

body.zh: 用于比较无监督预训练形成的表示、探索行为及其下游适应效率，研究不同内在目标对后续控制的作用。
body.en: It compares representations and exploration from unsupervised pretraining and their downstream adaptation efficiency.

body.zh: 按下游任务回报及适应阶段的样本效率比较方法，并在控制域和具体目标间汇总。
body.en: Methods are evaluated using downstream returns and adaptation sample efficiency across control domains and goals.

body.zh: 包括 Walker、Quadruped 和 Jaco 三个控制域的任务，采用无奖励预训练与有奖励微调两个阶段。
body.en: Walker, Quadruped and Jaco tasks use reward-free pretraining followed by reward-based adaptation.

body.zh: BuildArena在《围攻》中让语言模型根据自然语言目标构造运输、承重和升空机械。模型调用构造工具生成BSG机器文件，再由游戏物理仿真检验机械的实际行为。
body.en: BuildArena asks language models to construct transport, support and lift machines in Besiege from natural-language specifications. Models use construction tools to produce BSG machine files, whose behavior is tested in the game’s physics simulation.

body.zh: 用于研究工程构造、三维空间组合与物理推理，并分析结构设计能否满足功能约束。单轮生成与仿真反馈修正分别用于比较初始设计质量和迭代改进效果。
body.en: It supports research on engineering construction, 3D spatial composition and physical reasoning under functional constraints. One-shot generation and simulation-feedback refinement provide separate settings for initial design quality and iterative improvement.

body.zh: 按运输、承重和升空任务的轨迹判定成功率，并记录承重或高度等任务量、部件数、非法动作率与模型调用量。官方基线按任务类别和难度汇总，每个任务—模型组合采样64次。
body.en: Simulation trajectories determine task success; evaluation also records task-specific load or height, part count, invalid-action rate and model calls. Official baselines aggregate results by task category and difficulty, with 64 samples per task–model pair.

body.zh: 资源覆盖三类机械任务及三档难度，构造文件和仿真轨迹为主要研究产物。原始BuildArena的单轮与反馈实验分别记录；后续BuildArena 2.0属于独立扩展版本。
body.en: The resource covers three machine-task categories at three difficulty levels, with construction files and simulation trajectories as the main research artifacts. One-shot and feedback experiments are recorded separately; BuildArena 2.0 is a subsequent extension.

body.zh: CWMB 包含 18 个 RL 环境的描述与轨迹；另在简化 RTFM 评价代码模型与规划。
body.en: CWMB supplies descriptions and trajectories for 18 RL environments; a simplified RTFM tests model generation and planning.

body.zh: 用于研究 LLM 生成可执行动力学模型，以及模型准确性对搜索规划回报的影响。GIF-MCTS 以搜索和执行反馈改进生成代码。
body.en: It studies executable dynamics generation and its effects on planning, with GIF-MCTS refining code through search and feedback.

body.zh: 转换/奖励/终止预测准确率、规划归一化回报及合成预算。
body.en: Transition/reward/termination accuracy, normalized planning return and synthesis budget.

body.zh: OGameData 游戏录像支持生成和指令控制视频；Cyberpunk 2077 与 RDR2 为原文明确数据示例。
body.en: OGameData supports video generation and instructed control; Cyberpunk 2077 and RDR2 are explicitly identified data examples.

body.zh: 用于研究开放场景视频生成、动作可控性与指令驱动的连续画面变化。游戏录像为生成模型提供训练数据。
body.en: It studies open-domain video generation, action controllability and instruction-driven visual dynamics using gameplay footage.

body.zh: FID/FVD、文字对齐、偏好、视频质量及角色/环境控制响应率。
body.en: FID/FVD, text alignment, preference, video quality and character/event response rates.

body.zh: 评测对象为合成视频及控制响应，使用 OGameData 数据与对应视频生成协议。
body.en: Evaluation concerns generated video and control responses using OGameData and the associated generation protocol.

body.zh: MC-EvoBench 以 80 任务/19 链的图目录和阶段验证器审计即时执行与经验迁移；重点是三类配对迁移探针。
body.en: MC-EvoBench audits immediate execution and experience transfer with an 80-task/19-chain graph and stage verifiers, focusing on three paired-transfer probe families.

body.zh: 用于研究经验驱动的改进与跨任务迁移，通过阶段验证器和配对探针分析经验产物对后续执行的作用。

body.en: Protocols distinguish main chains, calibration chains and transfer probes, resetting target worlds and transferring declared experience artifacts.

body.zh: MultiWorldBench 用 Minecraft 双玩家引擎重放参考评估视频/世界模型的独立控制和共享世界一致性。

body.zh: ALE 基于 Atari 2600 模拟器提供游戏交互，智能体从像素或 RAM 等观测选择控制台动作。游戏涵盖射击、平台、迷宫等机制。
body.en: ALE exposes Atari 2600 games through pixel or RAM observations and console actions across shooting, platform and maze mechanics.

body.zh: 用于研究通用强化学习、视觉表征与跨任务性能比较，在共享动作接口下考察不同 Atari 游戏的学习过程。
body.en: It supports general RL, visual representations and cross-task comparisons across Atari games using shared action interfaces.

body.zh: 按游戏统计回报与重复运行结果；跨游戏比较使用所选协议的归一化和聚合规则。
body.en: Per-game returns and repeated-run outcomes are combined using protocol-specific normalization and aggregation.

body.zh: 具体协议由 ROM、游戏模式、随机性、帧跳过与交互预算定义，原始评测与后续随机动作设置分别指定。
body.en: ROMs, modes, stochasticity, frame skipping and budgets define each protocol, including distinct historical and later sticky-action settings.

body.zh: DeepMind Lab 是基于 Quake III 的三维研究环境，智能体从第一人称画面执行导航和对象交互，在地图中寻找目标或奖励。
body.en: DeepMind Lab is a Quake III-based 3D environment where agents navigate and interact with objects from first-person views.

body.zh: 用于研究第一人称导航、空间记忆与视觉强化学习，程序化地图和任务脚本支持受控场景变化。
body.en: It supports first-person navigation, spatial memory and visual RL through procedural maps and scripted tasks.

body.zh: 各关卡按目标和奖励事件累计回报，迷宫任务可观察目标获取与探索进展。
body.en: Level-specific objectives and reward events determine returns, including goal acquisition and exploration in mazes.

body.zh: 实验单位为关卡脚本与对应观测、动作、种子和时间预算，包含导航及解谜等任务。
body.en: Level scripts, observations, actions, seeds and time limits define navigation, puzzle and related experiments.

body.zh: GVGAI 使用通用游戏描述组织多种二维游戏，提供状态、动作和部分赛道中的前向模拟接口，智能体在不同规则下完成游戏目标。
body.en: GVGAI organizes 2D games with general game descriptions, exposing states, actions and track-dependent forward simulation.

body.zh: 用于研究跨游戏决策、前向模型规划、学习与程序化内容生成，比较方法对不同游戏规则的适应。
body.en: It supports cross-game decisions, forward-model planning, learning and procedural content generation across diverse rules.

body.zh: 游玩赛道通常统计胜负、游戏分数与完成时间，生成赛道另按内容和相应评价程序计分。
body.en: Playing tracks use wins, scores and completion times; generation tracks apply their own content-evaluation procedures.

body.zh: 框架由不同赛道和游戏集合组成，前向模型访问、训练机会与关卡划分由赛道协议指定。
body.en: Tracks define game sets, forward-model access, learning opportunities and level splits.

body.zh: 面向强化学习泛化评估的原版 CoinRun 基准。
body.en: Original CoinRun benchmark for generalization in RL.

body.zh: 用于研究强化学习泛化与训练关卡多样性，比较正则化、数据规模及策略结构对测试表现的影响。
body.en: It studies RL generalization and level diversity, comparing regularization, data scale and policy architecture.

body.zh: 报告训练与测试关卡上的回合回报或取币成功情况，分布间表现差反映策略泛化。
body.en: Returns or coin-reaching success on training and test levels characterize generalization gaps.

body.zh: 本条目对应原版 CoinRun。评测定义训练关卡数量与测试采样过程，并记录难度、随机种子及交互预算。
body.en: This is original CoinRun, evaluated with specified training-level counts, test sampling, difficulty, seeds and budgets.

body.zh: 程序化生成的第三人称三维高塔评测环境，包含强化学习与人类基线。
body.en: Procedurally generated third-person 3D tower benchmark with RL and human baselines.

body.zh: 用于研究视觉导航、控制与程序化环境泛化，多层结构要求结合局部操作、钥匙收集与路径决策。
body.en: It studies visual navigation, control and procedural generalization through floor traversal, key collection and route decisions.

body.zh: 主要统计每回合完成楼层数及其分布，奖励由楼层通过或辅助任务事件产生。
body.en: Completed floors per episode and their distribution are central metrics, with rewards for floor completion or auxiliary events.

body.zh: 论文实测原型为25层，后续环境设计和竞赛版本具有各自配置；视觉主题、种子与奖励模式定义测试条件。
body.en: The paper evaluates a 25-floor prototype; later designs and competition versions have separate configurations, themes, seeds and reward modes.

body.zh: 在 VGC 双打中检验智能体使用不同阵容的能力，提供 RL、行为克隆、LLM 与启发式基线。
body.en: Evaluates piloting diverse VGC doubles teams with RL, behavior-cloning, LLM and heuristic baselines.

body.zh: 用于研究双打协作决策、阵容泛化和竞技策略学习，并比较 RL、行为克隆、LLM 与启发式基线。
body.en: It studies doubles decisions, team-composition generalization and competitive policies across RL, cloning, LLM and heuristic baselines.

body.zh: 交叉对战胜率、Alpha-Rank、未见阵容泛化、训练对手得到的可利用性估计。
body.en: Cross-play win rates, Alpha-Rank, unseen-team generalization and trained-exploiter estimates.

body.zh: 智能体使用给定队伍进行对战，训练阵容规模、留出阵容、对手池与比赛局数定义实验。
body.en: Agents pilot given teams; training diversity, held-out teams, opponent populations and match counts define experiments.

body.zh: 自动生成新游戏并训练 RL 对手，用游戏说明、棋盘状态和合法动作评测 LLM 下棋。
body.en: Generates novel games and RL opponents; LLMs play from rules, board state and legal actions.

body.zh: 用于研究模型对新规则的理解与策略适应，自动生成的游戏分布支持比较新任务中的竞争表现。
body.en: It studies understanding novel rules and adapting strategies through automatically generated competitive games.

body.zh: 对 RL 对手的平均胜率、成本及失败类型。
body.en: Average win rate against RL opponents, cost and failure categories.

body.zh: 评测基于生成并筛选的双人游戏，LLM 读取规则、棋盘和合法动作，与对应训练的 RL 对手交互。
body.en: Generated and filtered two-player games present LLMs with rules, boards and legal actions against game-specific RL opponents.

sources.title: Measuring General Intelligence with Generated Games
gg-bench · official repository

body.zh: 13 个第一人称合作场景，以局部视觉、角色差异、同步行为与程序化地图研究 MARL。
body.en: Thirteen first-person cooperative scenarios combine local vision, asymmetric roles, synchronization and generated layouts.

body.zh: 用于研究具身多智能体强化学习中的分工、同步与空间协作，局部视觉和角色差异形成互相依赖的任务。
body.en: It studies role allocation, synchronization and spatial cooperation in embodied MARL with local vision and asymmetric roles.

body.zh: 场景原始得分与归一化得分、留出地图表现、学习曲线及多种子置信区间。
body.en: Scenario raw/normalized scores, held-out-layout performance, learning curves and multi-seed confidence intervals.

body.zh: 评测覆盖13个第一人称合作场景及程序生成布局，按场景、角色分配与地图划分组织实验。
body.en: Thirteen first-person scenarios and procedural layouts are evaluated by scenario, role assignment and map split.

body.zh: 将每步上下文拆为可消融的有界记忆层，在《杀戮尖塔 2》中研究长期决策，发布 298 条轨迹。
body.en: Ablatable bounded memory layers support long-horizon decisions in Slay the Spire 2; 298 trajectories are released.

body.zh: 用于研究有界记忆设计对长期决策的影响，通过记忆层和提示组件消融分析跨战斗信息组织。
body.en: It studies bounded memory in long-horizon decisions through ablations of memory layers and prompt components.

body.zh: 固定难度胜率及置信区间、进度与难度阶梯结果、token 和成本。
body.en: Fixed-difficulty win rates with confidence intervals, progress/difficulty-ladder results, tokens and cost.

body.zh: 实验区分固定难度完整对局、自动难度爬升和模型迁移，轨迹记录包含战斗、组牌、路线与事件决策。
body.en: Experiments separate fixed-difficulty runs, automatic difficulty progression and model transfer across combat, deckbuilding, routes and events.

AgenticSTS · official repository

body.zh: 面向实时格斗的 LLM 竞赛，限定提示工程或最多 7B 模型微调。
body.en: A real-time fighting competition using prompt engineering or fine-tuned LLMs up to 7B parameters.

body.zh: 用于研究语言模型在实时格斗中的状态理解、招式选择与反馈控制，竞赛设置连接提示工程和模型策略。
body.en: It studies state understanding, move selection and feedback control in real-time fighting through prompting and model policies.

body.zh: 参考代理记录双方剩余生命值、经过帧数和伤害差奖励，描述单回合格斗过程。
body.en: The reference agent records remaining HP, elapsed frames and damage-difference rewards to characterize individual rounds.

body.zh: 现有任务依据官方 LLM 参考代理的实际对战接口。赛事排名公式和最终参赛约束以2026规则包为准。
body.en: Registered tasks follow the official LLM reference-match interface; final rankings and participation constraints follow the 2026 rules package.
